exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 15 — Take a Break
exercises.instructionUz: 15-UNIT — Dam oling
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT NOMINING MA'NOSI:
  'Take a Break'
  = Dam oling; tanaffus qiling

  'to TAKE A BREAK' — turg'un ibora:
     'Let's take a break.' = Dam olaylik.
     'a break' = tanaffus, dam

  Bu yerda unit mavzusi TA'TIL va SAYOHAT
  bo'lgani uchun ikki ma'noli:
     • ishdan dam olish
     • ta'tilga chiqish

  'a short break' — qisqa ta'til (2-3 kun).


UNIT 15 NING GRAMMATIKASI
(Grammar Book 64-bet sarlavhasidan):
  • PRESENT PERFECT
  • PAST SIMPLE bilan farqi
  • EVER / NEVER
  • JUST
  • YET / ALREADY
  • FOR / SINCE

  Bu — butun kitobdagi ENG MUHIM
  grammatik mavzulardan biri.


UNITNING JOYI: MISR (EGYPT), QOHIRA (CAIRO)

  Betdagi yetti rasm — Misrning eng mashhur
  ko'rinishlari:
     • Nil daryosidagi yelkanli qayiq (felucca)
     • Khan al-Khalili bozori
     • Ehrom (piramida) va tuyali odam
     • Sfenks
     • Misr muzeyi ichkarisi
     • Tutanxamonning oltin niqobi
     • Sfenkslar xiyoboni


BU BETDA PRESENT PERFECT BIRINChI MARTA
UChRAYDI:

  1-mashqda:
     'HAVE you EVER BEEN there?'
     (Hech u yerda bo'lganmisiz?)

  3-mashqda:
     'I HAVE ALREADY VISITED the bazaar.'
     'I HAVEN'T SEEN the Pyramids.'
     'I'VE BEEN to a restaurant.'

  Yasalishi:
     HAVE / HAS + III shakl (V3)

  Ma'nosi: o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan, lekin
  VAQTI aytilmagan yoki HOZIRGA aloqador
  harakat.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to take a break = dam olmoq
  a break        = tanaffus, dam
  Egypt          = Misr
  Cairo          = Qohira
  the River Nile = Nil daryosi
  a Pyramid      = ehrom, piramida
  the Sphinx     = Sfenks
  a Pharaoh      = fir'avn
  a camel        = tuya
  a bazaar       = bozor
  an exhibit     = eksponat (muzeyda)
  a statue       = haykal

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Which country are they from? Have you ever been there? If so, when and why?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Ular qaysi mamlakatdan? Hech u yerda bo'lganmisiz? Agar shunday bo'lsa, qachon va nima uchun?
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOB: EGYPT (Misr).

Aniqrog'i — CAIRO (Qohira) va uning
atrofidagi mashhur joylar.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — RASMLARDAGI BELGILAR:

  • EHROMLAR (Pyramids) — faqat Misrda
    (Gizadagi uchta buyuk ehrom)
  • SFENKS — Gizadagi mashhur haykal
  • NIL daryosi va felucca (yelkanli qayiq)
  • TUTANXAMONNING OLTIN NIQOBI —
    Qohiradagi Misr muzeyida saqlanadi
  • KHAN AL-KHALILI — Qohiradagi eng mashhur
    bozor
  • SFENKSLAR XIYOBONI — Luqsordagi
    ma'badlarga olib boruvchi yo'l

  2-mashqning e-bandi ('the Khan al-Khalili
  bazaar') va f-bandi ('the River Nile')
  javobni ochiq aytib turibdi.


SAVOLLARGA NAMUNA JAVOBLAR:

  'Which country are they from?'
     → They are from Egypt.

  'HAVE YOU EVER BEEN there?'
     → Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
       (Ha, bo'lganman. / Yo'q, bo'lmaganman.)

  'If so, when and why?'
     → I went there two years ago. I went on
       holiday with my family.


⚠ ENG MUHIM GRAMMATIK NUQTA — BU UNITNING
KALITI:

  'HAVE you EVER BEEN there?'
     → PRESENT PERFECT
     → VAQT aytilmagan, faqat 'hech qachon
       bo'lganmi' degan savol

  'WHEN did you GO?'
     → PAST SIMPLE
     → endi ANIQ VAQT so'ralyapti

  Ya'ni:
     TAJRIBA haqida so'rasa  →  Present Perfect
     VAQT haqida so'rasa     →  Past Simple

  Shuning uchun javob ham shunday:
     'Yes, I HAVE.' (tajriba)
     'I WENT there two years ago.' (vaqt)

  'I have been there two years ago' — XATO!
  (Present Perfect ANIQ VAQT bilan
   ishlatilmaydi.)


DIQQAT — 'HAVE BEEN TO' va 'HAVE GONE TO':

  'I have BEEN to Egypt.'
     = Misrda bo'lganman (va QAYTIB kelganman)

  'He has GONE to Egypt.'
     = U Misrga ketgan (va HALI U YERDA)

  Bu — juda muhim farq!


DIQQAT — 'EVER':
  'ever' = hech qachon (SAVOLDA)
  'Have you EVER been ...?' = hech bo'lganmisiz?

  Inkorda 'NEVER':
  'I have NEVER been to Egypt.'

  DIQQAT: 'never' o'zi INKOR, shuning uchun
  'haven't never' XATO!


DIQQAT — 'IF SO':
  'If so, when and why?'
  'if so' = agar shunday bo'lsa
  (oldingi savolga 'ha' deb javob berilsa)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Egypt        = Misr
  ever         = hech qachon (savolda)
  never        = hech qachon (inkorda)
  if so        = agar shunday bo'lsa

exercises.instructionEn: Which picture shows:
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi rasm quyidagilarni ko'rsatadi:
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI RASM (1-7), SAKKIZ BAND (a-h).
Demak BITTA rasm IKKI bandga mos keladi.


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

  1  Nil daryosidagi katta uchburchak yelkanli
     qayiq (FELUCCA), quyosh botishi fonida
  2  Bozor rastasi: osilgan kiyimlar, uchta
     odam (ikkitasi qizil fes kiygan sotuvchi)
     bir qo'lda katta surat ushlab turishibdi
  3  Sariq EHROM va uning oldida bezakli
     TUYADAGI odam
  4  SFENKS — odam boshli, sher tanali ulkan
     haykal
  5  MUZEY ichkarisi: baland ustunlar orasida
     ulkan fir'avn haykallari
  6  TUTANXAMONNING oltin-ko'k yo'lli niqobi
  7  Ikki qator bo'lib cho'zilgan SFENKS
     haykallari (xiyobon)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  a  a Pyramid?              →  3
  b  the Sphinx?             →  4
  c  a man on a camel?       →  3
  d  museum exhibits?        →  5
  e  the Khan al-Khalili bazaar? →  2
  f  a boat on the River Nile?   →  1
  g  a Pharaoh's mask?       →  6
  h  statues of lions?       →  7


DIQQAT — 3-RASM IKKI BANDGA MOS:
  Bu rasmda IKKALASI ham bor:
     • EHROM (a Pyramid) — orqa fonda
     • TUYADAGI ODAM (a man on a camel) —
       oldinda

  Shuning uchun a va c bandlari IKKALASI
  ham 3-rasmga tegishli.
  (7 rasm, 8 band — bu tabiiy.)


DIQQAT — 4 va 7-RASMLAR FARQI:

  4  THE SPHINX (aniq artikl 'THE') —
     Gizadagi YAGONA mashhur Sfenks.
     Katta, yolg'iz, odam boshli.

  7  STATUES OF LIONS — Luqsordagi
     SFENKSLAR XIYOBONI: ikki qator kichik
     haykallar.

  Nega 'lions' deyilgan? Chunki sfenksning
  TANASI SHERNIKI. Kitob soddaroq so'z
  ishlatgan.

  Farqi: 4 — bitta ulkan; 7 — ko'p va qatorda.


DIQQAT — 6-RASM, 'A PHARAOH'S MASK':
  Bu — TUTANXAMONNING dafn niqobi
  (mil. avv. 1323-yil), sof oltindan.
  Qohiradagi Misr muzeyida saqlanadi.

  'a Pharaoh'S mask' — EGALIK apostrofi
  ('fir'avnning niqobi').


DIQQAT — 5-RASM va 'MUSEUM EXHIBITS':
  'an EXHIBIT' = muzeydagi ko'rgazma buyumi
  ('an EXHIBITION' = ko'rgazma — BOSHQA so'z!)

     exhibit    — bitta buyum
     exhibition — butun ko'rgazma


DIQQAT — 2-RASM, 'BAZAAR':
  'Khan al-Khalili' — Qohiradagi eng mashhur
  bozor (XIV asrdan beri ishlaydi).

  'a bazaar' — sharq bozori
  ('a market' — umumiy so'z).


DIQQAT — 1-RASM, 'FELUCCA':
  Nil daryosidagi an'anaviy yelkanli qayiq.
  Uchburchak yelkani bilan tanilgan.

  Kitob soddaroq aytgan: 'a boat on the
  River Nile'.

  DIQQAT: 'the River Nile' — daryo nomlari
  DOIM 'THE' bilan (Grammar 63-bet qoidasi).


GAP TUZISh (rasm tasvirlash):
  'Picture 3 shows a Pyramid.'
  'Picture 4 shows the Sphinx.'
  'I can see a boat on the River Nile in
   picture 1.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a Pyramid    = ehrom, piramida
  the Sphinx   = Sfenks
  a camel      = tuya
  an exhibit   = eksponat
  a bazaar     = sharq bozori
  a Pharaoh    = fir'avn
  a mask       = niqob
  a statue     = haykal
  a lion       = sher

exercises.instructionEn: Jack went on holiday to Cairo. Read the sentences, then listen to the letter Jack sent to his friend and mark the sentences as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Jek Qohiraga ta'tilga bordi. Gaplarni o'qing, so'ngra Jek do'stiga yuborgan xatni tinglang va gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — AUDIO ShART EMAS:
  Jekning xati 105-betda TO'LIQ bosilgan!
  Beshala javob xatdan SO'ZMA-SO'Z
  tasdiqlanadi.

  4-mashq ham aynan shu xat bilan ishlaydi:
  'READ THE LETTER and underline ...'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  T   (kitobda berilgan)
  2  F
  3  T
  4  F
  5  T


HAR BIRI — XATDAN DALIL:

 1  'I have already visited the Khan
     al-Khalili bazaar.'
    XATDA: 'I've ALREADY VISITED the Khan
    al-Khalili bazaar.'
    → T (KITOBDA BERILGAN)

 2  'I haven't seen the Pyramids or the
     Sphinx.'
    XATDA: 'I HAVE ALSO SEEN the Pyramids and
    the Sphinx at Giza. I saw them yesterday.'
    → F (u KO'RGAN!)

 3  'I've been to a traditional restaurant.'
    XATDA: 'I'VE BEEN TO A TRADITIONAL
    RESTAURANT. Abdullah took me there last
    night.'
    → T

 4  'I have been on a boat trip down the River
     Nile.'
    XATDA: 'I HAVEN'T BEEN on a boat trip down
    the River Nile YET.'
    → F (hali BORMAGAN!)

 5  'I haven't visited the Egyptian Museum.'
    XATDA: 'and I HAVEN'T VISITED the Egyptian
    Museum.'
    → T


JEK NIMA QILGAN va NIMA QILMAGAN:

  ✓ QILGAN (Present Perfect, tasdiq):
     • visited the Khan al-Khalili bazaar
     • seen the Pyramids and the Sphinx
     • rode a camel
     • been to a traditional restaurant

  ✗ HALI QILMAGAN (Present Perfect, inkor +
    'yet'):
     • been on a boat trip down the Nile
     • visited the Egyptian Museum


⚠ ENG MUHIM GRAMMATIK NUQTA:

  Bu mashqda PRESENT PERFECT ning UCh
  ko'rsatkichi bor:

  ALREADY — allaqachon (TASDIQ gapda)
     'I have ALREADY visited ...'
     Odatda 'have' va V3 ORASIDA turadi.

  YET — hali (INKOR gapda, GAP OXIRIDA)
     'I haven't been ... YET.'

  Ikkalasi ham Present Perfect bilan
  ishlatiladi.


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDAGI 'OR':
  'I haven't seen the Pyramids OR the Sphinx.'

  INKOR gapda 'and' emas, 'OR':
     'I haven't seen A or B.'  ✓
     'I haven't seen A and B.' — ma'no biroz
       boshqa

  Xatda esa TASDIQ gap, shuning uchun 'AND':
     'I have seen the Pyramids AND the Sphinx.'


DIQQAT — 'I'VE BEEN TO':
  'I'VE BEEN TO a traditional restaurant.'
  = restoranda bo'lganman (va qaytganman)

  'been TO' — predlog 'to' SHART.
  'I've been IN a restaurant' — boshqa ma'no
  (ichkarida bo'lish).


DIQQAT — 'A BOAT TRIP DOWN THE NILE':
  'DOWN the river' = daryo BO'YLAB (oqim
  yo'nalishida)
  'UP the river' = daryoga qarshi

  Nil JANUBDAN SHIMOLGA oqadi, shuning uchun
  'down the Nile' — shimolga qarab.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  already      = allaqachon
  yet          = hali (inkorda)
  traditional  = an'anaviy
  a boat trip  = qayiqda sayohat
  the Egyptian Museum = Misr muzeyi
  true / false = to'g'ri / noto'g'ri

tasks.prompt: 1  I have already visited the Khan al-Khalili bazaar.
tasks.whyUz:
KITOBDA BERILGAN (namuna).

XATDAN SO'ZMA-SO'Z:
'I've ALREADY VISITED the Khan al-Khalili
bazaar. We visited it on Tuesday.'

'ALREADY' — Present Perfect ning TASDIQ
ko'rsatkichi, 'have' va V3 orasida turadi.

tasks.prompt: 2  I haven't seen the Pyramids or the Sphinx.
tasks.whyUz:
XATDA TESKARISI aytilgan:
'I HAVE ALSO SEEN the Pyramids and the Sphinx
at Giza. I SAW THEM YESTERDAY. They were
amazing.'

Demak u KO'RGAN → gap NOTO'G'RI → F.

DIQQAT: xatda 'I have SEEN' (Present Perfect)
va darhol 'I SAW them yesterday' (Past Simple)
— chunki ANIQ VAQT ('yesterday') aytilganda
Past Simple ishlatiladi.

tasks.prompt: 3  I've been to a traditional restaurant.
tasks.whyUz:
XATDAN SO'ZMA-SO'Z:
'I'VE BEEN TO A TRADITIONAL RESTAURANT.
Abdullah took me there last night. I tried
couscous and falafel.'

→ T

'been TO' — predlog 'to' SHART.

tasks.prompt: 4  I have been on a boat trip down the River Nile.
tasks.promptUz: Nil daryosi bo'ylab qayiqda sayohat qilganman.
tasks.whyUz:
XATDA INKOR shaklda:
'I HAVEN'T BEEN on a boat trip down the River
Nile YET.'

Demak hali BORMAGAN → gap NOTO'G'RI → F.

'YET' — Present Perfect ning INKOR
ko'rsatkichi, GAP OXIRIDA turadi.

Xatda davomi ham bor: 'We are GOING ON a
boat trip TOMORROW' — ya'ni hali oldinda.

tasks.prompt: 5  I haven't visited the Egyptian Museum.
tasks.whyUz:
XATDAN SO'ZMA-SO'Z:
'... and I HAVEN'T VISITED the Egyptian
Museum.'

→ T (gap xat bilan bir xil)

DIQQAT: bu — INKOR gap va u TO'G'RI.
O'quvchilar ko'pincha inkor gapni avtomatik
'F' deb belgilaydi — bu xato.
Gapning MA'NOSI xatga mos kelsa, javob T.

exercises.instructionEn: Jack's letter to Terry
exercises.instructionUz: Jekning Terriga yozgan xati
exercises.explanationUz:
XATNING TO'LIQ MATNI:

  Dear Terry,

  Greetings from Cairo! The weather is very hot
  here and I'm having a wonderful time. I'm
  staying with my friend, Abdullah. He lives in
  the centre of Cairo.

  I've been here since Monday and I've already
  done lots of things! I've already visited the
  Khan al-Khalili bazaar. We visited it on
  Tuesday. You can't imagine how noisy and
  crowded it was! I bought some lovely handmade
  souvenirs there. I have also seen the
  Pyramids and the Sphinx at Giza. I saw them
  yesterday. They were amazing. I even rode a
  camel. It was fun! I've been to a traditional
  restaurant. Abdullah took me there last
  night. I tried couscous and falafel. The
  place was fantastic and the food was just
  delicious.

  There are a lot of things I haven't done yet.
  I haven't been on a boat trip down the River
  Nile yet, and I haven't visited the Egyptian
  Museum. We are going on a boat trip tomorrow
  and we are going to visit the museum one of
  these days to see the exhibits. We are also
  going to visit Luxor. The place is famous for
  its huge temples and statues.

  Cairo is a fascinating city — you must visit
  it one day! Anyway, I'm returning to England
  on Sunday next week, so I'll call you then.

                            Best wishes,
                            Jack


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Terri,

  Qohiradan salom! Bu yerda havo juda issiq va
  men ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapman. Do'stim
  Abdulloh bilan turibman. U Qohira markazida
  yashaydi.

  Dushanbadan beri shu yerdaman va allaqachon
  ko'p ish qildim! Khan al-Khalili bozoriga
  allaqachon borganman. Uni seshanba kuni
  ko'rdik. Uning qanchalik shovqinli va
  gavjum ekanini tasavvur qila olmaysan! U
  yerdan chiroyli qo'lbola sovg'alar sotib
  oldim. Yana Gizadagi ehromlar va Sfenksni
  ko'rdim. Ularni kecha ko'rdim. Ular
  hayratlanarli edi. Hatto tuyaga ham mindim.
  Qiziq bo'ldi! An'anaviy restoranda
  bo'ldim. Abdulloh meni o'tgan kecha u yerga
  olib bordi. Kuskus va falafel yeb ko'rdim.
  Joy ajoyib edi, ovqat esa juda mazali edi.

  Hali qilmagan ko'p ishlarim bor. Hali Nil
  daryosi bo'ylab qayiqda sayohat qilmadim va
  Misr muzeyiga bormadim. Ertaga qayiqda
  sayohatga chiqamiz va shu kunlarning birida
  eksponatlarni ko'rish uchun muzeyga boramiz.
  Yana Luqsorga ham boramiz. U joy ulkan
  ma'badlari va haykallari bilan mashhur.

  Qohira — maftunkor shahar, bir kun kelib
  albatta borishing kerak! Xullas, kelasi hafta
  yakshanba kuni Angliyaga qaytaman, o'shanda
  senga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

                            Eng yaxshi tilaklar
                            bilan, Jek


⚠ XATNING GRAMMATIK TUZILIShI —
BU UNITNING ENG MUHIM DARSI:

  Xat UCh ZAMONNI aralashtiradi va har
  birining SABABI aniq:

  1) PRESENT PERFECT — VAQTI aytilmagan
     'I'VE BEEN here since Monday'
     'I've ALREADY VISITED the bazaar'
     'I HAVE ALSO SEEN the Pyramids'
     'I'VE BEEN TO a traditional restaurant'
     'I HAVEN'T BEEN on a boat trip YET'
     'I HAVEN'T VISITED the Egyptian Museum'

  2) PAST SIMPLE — ANIQ VAQT aytilgan
     'We VISITED it ON TUESDAY.'
     'I SAW them YESTERDAY.'
     'Abdullah TOOK me there LAST NIGHT.'
     'I BOUGHT some souvenirs.'
     'I TRIED couscous and falafel.'
     'I RODE a camel.'

  3) BE GOING TO — KELAJAK rejasi
     'We ARE GOING ON a boat trip tomorrow'
     'we ARE GOING TO VISIT the museum'
     'We ARE ALSO GOING TO VISIT Luxor'


ENG MUHIM NAQSh — E'TIBOR BERING:

  Jek har bir ishni AVVAL Present Perfect da
  aytadi (umumiy xabar), KEYIN Past Simple da
  tafsilotini beradi (aniq vaqt bilan):

     'I've already VISITED the bazaar.'
        (Present Perfect — xabar)
     'We VISITED it ON TUESDAY.'
        (Past Simple — aniq vaqt)

     'I have also SEEN the Pyramids.'
        (Present Perfect — xabar)
     'I SAW them YESTERDAY.'
        (Past Simple — aniq vaqt)

     'I've BEEN TO a traditional restaurant.'
        (Present Perfect — xabar)
     'Abdullah TOOK me there LAST NIGHT.'
        (Past Simple — aniq vaqt)

  BU — Unit 15 ning oltin qoidasi:
     VAQT AYTILMASA  →  Present Perfect
     VAQT AYTILSA    →  Past Simple


DIQQAT — 'SINCE MONDAY':
  'I've been here SINCE MONDAY.'
  = dushanbadan BERI

  'SINCE' — boshlanish NUQTASI
     since Monday, since 2010, since I came
  'FOR' — DAVOMIYLIK
     for three days, for two years

  Ikkalasi ham Present Perfect bilan.


DIQQAT — 'YET' QAYERDA TURADI:
  'There are a lot of things I haven't done
   YET.'
  'I haven't been on a boat trip ... YET.'

  'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA (inkor gapda).


DIQQAT — 'ALREADY' QAYERDA TURADI:
  'I've ALREADY done lots of things.'
  'I've ALREADY visited the bazaar.'

  'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA
  (tasdiq gapda).


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (xatdan):
  be    → was   → BEEN
  do    → did   → DONE
  see   → saw   → SEEN
  buy   → bought → BOUGHT
  ride  → rode  → RIDDEN
  take  → took  → TAKEN


DIQQAT — 'YOU CAN'T IMAGINE HOW ...':
  'You can't imagine HOW NOISY AND CROWDED
   IT WAS!'

  Ergash gapda so'z tartibi TO'G'RI
  (savol tartibi EMAS):
     'how noisy IT WAS'  ✓
     'how noisy WAS IT'  ✗


DIQQAT — 'ONE OF THESE DAYS':
  'one of these days' = shu kunlarning birida,
  yaqin kunlarda


DIQQAT — 'FAMOUS FOR':
  'The place is FAMOUS FOR its huge temples.'
  'famous FOR something' — predlog 'for'.

  ('famous AS' — sifat sifatida mashhur:
   'He is famous AS a singer.')


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Greetings from ... = ...dan salom
  to imagine     = tasavvur qilmoq
  crowded        = gavjum
  handmade       = qo'lbola
  a souvenir     = sovg'a, esdalik
  amazing        = hayratlanarli
  to ride        = minmoq (ride → RODE)
  couscous       = kuskus (Shimoliy Afrika taomi)
  falafel        = falafel (no'xat kotleti)
  fantastic      = ajoyib
  delicious      = juda mazali
  an exhibit     = eksponat
  Luxor          = Luqsor (Misrdagi shahar)
  a temple       = ma'bad
  huge           = ulkan
  fascinating    = maftunkor
  to return      = qaytmoq
  Anyway         = Xullas, har holda

1-gap PRESENT PERFECT (vaqt yo'q),

tasks.en: You can't imagine how noisy and crowded it was! I bought some lovely handmade souvenirs there.
tasks.uz: Uning qanchalik shovqinli va gavjum ekanini tasavvur qila olmaysan! U yerdan chiroyli qo'lbola sovg'alar sotib oldim.
tasks.note:
'how noisy IT WAS' — ergash gap tartibi
(savol tartibi EMAS).
buy → BOUGHT.

tasks.en: I have also seen the Pyramids and the Sphinx at Giza. I saw them yesterday. They were amazing. I even rode a camel.
tasks.uz: Yana Gizadagi ehromlar va Sfenksni ko'rdim. Ularni kecha ko'rdim. Ular hayratlanarli edi. Hatto tuyaga ham mindim.
tasks.note:
Yana o'sha naqsh: 'have SEEN' (Present Perfect)
→ 'I SAW them YESTERDAY' (Past Simple).
ride → RODE.

Bu gap 4-RASMGA mos keladi (the Sphinx).

tasks.en: I've been to a traditional restaurant. Abdullah took me there last night. I tried couscous and falafel.
tasks.uz: An'anaviy restoranda bo'ldim. Abdulloh meni o'tgan kecha u yerga olib bordi. Kuskus va falafel yeb ko'rdim.
tasks.note:
'been TO' — predlog 'to'.
'took ... LAST NIGHT' — Past Simple.
couscous, falafel — Shimoliy Afrika taomlari.

tasks.en: There are a lot of things I haven't done yet. I haven't been on a boat trip down the River Nile yet, and I haven't visited the Egyptian Museum.
tasks.uz: Hali qilmagan ko'p ishlarim bor. Hali Nil bo'ylab qayiqda sayohat qilmadim va Misr muzeyiga bormadim.
tasks.note:
PRESENT PERFECT INKOR + 'YET'.
'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA.
'DOWN the river' = daryo bo'ylab.

tasks.en: We are going on a boat trip tomorrow and we are going to visit the museum one of these days to see the exhibits.
tasks.uz: Ertaga qayiqda sayohatga chiqamiz va shu kunlarning birida eksponatlarni ko'rish uchun muzeyga boramiz.
tasks.note:
BE GOING TO — kelajak REJASI (Unit 13).
'one of these days' = yaqin kunlarda.
'TO see' — maqsad.

tasks.en: We are also going to visit Luxor. The place is famous for its huge temples and statues.
tasks.uz: Yana Luqsorga ham boramiz. U joy ulkan ma'badlari va haykallari bilan mashhur.
tasks.note:
'famous FOR something' — predlog 'for'.

Bu gap 7-RASMGA mos keladi (statues of lions —
Luqsordagi sfenkslar xiyoboni).

tasks.en: Cairo is a fascinating city — you must visit it one day! Anyway, I'm returning to England on Sunday next week, so I'll call you then.
tasks.uz: Qohira — maftunkor shahar, bir kun kelib albatta borishing kerak! Xullas, kelasi hafta yakshanba kuni Angliyaga qaytaman, o'shanda senga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.
tasks.note:
'you MUST visit' — qat'iy tavsiya (Unit 14).
'I'M RETURNING ... on Sunday' — Present
Continuous, aniq vaqtli reja (Unit 13).
'I'LL call' — va'da (Unit 13).

                            (bilvosita)

  yettalasi ham xatda aks etgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to underline = tagiga chizmoq
  to match     = mos kelmoq
  Giza         = Giza (Qohira yaqinidagi joy)
  Luxor        = Luqsor

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N SAVOL — BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  Where is Jack?
    → He is in Cairo, Egypt.
    (U Misrning Qohira shahrida.)

 2  What is the weather like there?
    → It is very hot.
    (Havo juda issiq.)

 3  Who is Jack staying with?
    → He is staying with his friend, Abdullah.
    (Do'sti Abdulloh bilan turibdi.)

 4  How long has Jack been there?
    → He has been there since Monday.
    (U dushanbadan beri o'sha yerda.)

 5  What did Jack do on Tuesday?
    → He visited the Khan al-Khalili bazaar
      and bought some handmade souvenirs.
    (Khan al-Khalili bozoriga bordi va qo'lbola
     sovg'alar sotib oldi.)

 6  What did he do yesterday?
    → He saw the Pyramids and the Sphinx at
      Giza, and he rode a camel.
    (Gizadagi ehromlar va Sfenksni ko'rdi va
     tuyaga mindi.)

 7  What hasn't he done yet?
    → He hasn't been on a boat trip down the
      River Nile and he hasn't visited the
      Egyptian Museum.
    (Nil bo'ylab qayiqda sayohat qilmagan va
     Misr muzeyiga bormagan.)

 8  What is he going to do before he leaves?
    → He is going to go on a boat trip, visit
      the Egyptian Museum and visit Luxor.
    (Qayiqda sayohatga chiqadi, Misr muzeyiga
     va Luqsorga boradi.)

 9  When is he returning to England?
    → He is returning on Sunday next week.
    (Kelasi hafta yakshanba kuni qaytadi.)

10  What does he think of the place?
    → He thinks Cairo is a fascinating city.
    (Uning fikricha, Qohira maftunkor shahar.)


⚠ SAVOLNING ZAMONI JAVOBNING ZAMONINI
BELGILAYDI — BU MASHQNING ASOSIY DARSI:

  SAVOL                    JAVOB
  ─────────────────────    ──────────────────
  'WHERE IS Jack?'         'He IS in Cairo.'
     Present Simple           Present Simple

  'HOW LONG HAS he BEEN?'  'He HAS BEEN since
     Present Perfect          Monday.'
                              Present Perfect

  'What DID he DO on       'He VISITED ...'
   Tuesday?'                  Past Simple
     Past Simple

  'What HASN'T he DONE     'He HASN'T BEEN ...'
   yet?'                      Present Perfect
     Present Perfect

  'What IS he GOING TO     'He IS GOING TO ...'
   do?'                       be going to
     be going to

  Ya'ni savolni DIQQAT bilan o'qish yetarli —
  javobning zamoni o'zi ma'lum bo'ladi.


DIQQAT — 4-SAVOL, 'HOW LONG':
  'HOW LONG has Jack been there?'
  = qancha vaqtdan beri?

  Javob IKKI xil bo'lishi mumkin:
     'SINCE Monday.'  (boshlanish nuqtasi)
     'FOR a few days.' (davomiylik)

  Xatda 'SINCE Monday' berilgan.

  'How long' savoli DOIM Present Perfect
  bilan (agar hali davom etayotgan bo'lsa).


DIQQAT — 2-SAVOL, 'WHAT IS IT LIKE?':
  'What IS the weather LIKE?'
  = havo qanday?

  DIQQAT: bu yerda 'like' — 'yoqmoq' EMAS,
  'qanday' ma'nosida.

     'What is it LIKE?'   = u qanday?
     'What do you LIKE?'  = nima yoqadi?

  Javobda 'like' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     'It is very hot.'  ✓
     'It is like hot.'  ✗


DIQQAT — 10-SAVOL, 'WHAT DOES HE THINK OF':
  'What does he THINK OF the place?'
  = u joy haqida qanday fikrda?

  'think OF / think ABOUT something' —
  fikr so'rash.

  Javob: 'He thinks (that) Cairo is
  fascinating.'


DIQQAT — 8-SAVOL, 'BEFORE HE LEAVES':
  'before he LEAVES' — kelasi zamon ma'nosi,
  lekin PRESENT SIMPLE ishlatiladi!

  'before / after / when' bog'lovchilaridan
  keyin 'will' ishlatilmaydi:
     'before he LEAVES'      ✓
     'before he WILL LEAVE'  ✗


JAVOBLARDA OLMOSh O'ZGARADI:
  Xatda: 'I'm staying with MY friend'
  Javobda: 'HE is staying with HIS friend'

  Xat BIRINCHI shaxsda, javob UChINChI
  shaxsda bo'ladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  How long ...?    = qancha vaqtdan beri?
  What is it like? = u qanday?
  to think of      = ... haqida fikrda bo'lmoq
  to leave         = ketmoq, jo'namoq

exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni tinglang va kuzating, so'ngra uni o'qing va qavs ichidagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. Yana tinglab tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIYAT: Pol va Piter MADRIDDA kutilmaganda
uchrashib qolishdi.

DIQQAT: dialog TO'LIQ bosilgan, shuning uchun
zamonlar matnning O'ZIDAN aniqlanadi —
audio faqat tekshirish uchun.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  HAVE YOU BEEN
   2  ARRIVED
   3  AM STAYING
   4  ARE YOU STAYING
   5  HAVE BEEN
   6  HAVE YOU VISITED
   7  HAVE ALREADY VISITED
   8  WENT
   9  SAW
  10  HAVE YOU BEEN
  11  WENT
  12  HAVE YOU BEEN
  13  AM GOING TO DO  (yoki WILL DO)
  14  WANT
  15  HAVE YOU TRIED
  16  WENT
  17  ARE YOU DOING
  18  AM GOING


TO'LIQ DIALOG (javoblar bilan):

  Paul:  Hello, Peter. What a surprise to meet
         you here in Madrid.
  Peter: Hey, Paul! Fancy meeting you here.
         This place is fantastic.
  Paul:  Yes, it is. How long HAVE YOU BEEN
         here?
  Peter: Oh, I ARRIVED last Saturday. I AM
         STAYING at the Monaco Hotel. Where
         ARE YOU STAYING?
  Paul:  With my friend Carlos. I HAVE BEEN
         here since last Monday.
  Peter: Which places HAVE YOU VISITED?
  Paul:  Well, I HAVE ALREADY VISITED the
         Prado Museum. I WENT there last
         Monday. It's fantastic. I SAW some
         beautiful paintings there. You really
         should go.
  Peter: I will, indeed. HAVE YOU BEEN to
         Palacio Real yet?
  Paul:  Yes, I WENT there yesterday. The
         state rooms were magnificent.
  Peter: That sounds nice. HAVE YOU BEEN
         shopping at all?
  Paul:  No, I haven't, but I AM GOING TO DO
         that soon. I WANT to go to the Rastro
         flea market to buy some souvenirs.
  Peter: That's a good idea. HAVE YOU TRIED
         paella yet?
  Paul:  Of course. I WENT to 'Lhardy'
         restaurant last night with some
         friends. The food was just delicious.
  Peter: I see you don't waste your time.
         What ARE YOU DOING tonight? Shall we
         go out for a drink?
  Paul:  I'd love to, but I can't. I AM GOING
         to the opera to see Carmen. But we
         can meet tomorrow.
  Peter: Okay, then. How about 7 o'clock at
         Bistro Café?
  Paul:  All right. See you tomorrow.
  Peter: See you.


ZAMONLAR BO'YIChA GURUHLAR:

  PRESENT PERFECT (vaqt aytilmagan) — 6 ta:
     1, 5, 6, 7, 10, 12, 15

  PAST SIMPLE (aniq vaqt) — 4 ta:
     2 (last Saturday), 8 (last Monday),
     9, 11 (yesterday), 16 (last night)

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — 4 ta:
     3, 4 (vaqtinchalik holat),
     17, 18 (kelajakdagi reja)

  PRESENT SIMPLE — 1 ta:
     14 (want — his fe'li)

  BE GOING TO — 1 ta:
     13 (yaqin reja)


HAR BIRI NEGA — BATAFSIL:

 1  'HOW LONG ... you/be here?'
    KALIT: 'HOW LONG' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU BEEN

 2  'I ... (arrive) LAST SATURDAY.'
    KALIT: 'LAST SATURDAY' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → ARRIVED

 3  'I ... (stay) at the Monaco Hotel.'
    Hozirgi VAQTINChALIK holat →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → AM STAYING
    ('I stay' — doimiy odat degan ma'no
     berardi)

 4  'Where ... (you/stay)?'
    3-band bilan bir xil savol shakli.
    → ARE YOU STAYING

 5  'I ... (be) here SINCE last Monday.'
    KALIT: 'SINCE' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE BEEN

 6  'Which places ... (you/visit)?'
    Vaqt aytilmagan, TAJRIBA so'ralyapti →
    PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU VISITED

 7  'I ... (ALREADY/visit) the Prado Museum.'
    KALIT: 'ALREADY' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    'already' — have va V3 ORASIDA.
    → HAVE ALREADY VISITED

 8  'I ... (go) there LAST MONDAY.'
    KALIT: 'LAST MONDAY' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → WENT

 9  'I ... (see) some beautiful paintings
     there.'
    8-band bilan bir xil vaqt (o'sha kun) →
    PAST SIMPLE.
    → SAW

10  '... (you/go) to Palacio Real YET?'
    KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU BEEN
    (Quyidagi izohga qarang.)

11  'Yes, I ... (go) there YESTERDAY.'
    KALIT: 'YESTERDAY' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → WENT

12  '... (you/be) shopping at all?'
    Vaqt aytilmagan, TAJRIBA →
    PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU BEEN

13  'but I ... (do) that SOON.'
    KALIT: 'SOON' — kelajak.
    Keyingi gap ('I want to go to the
    Rastro') niyat borligini ko'rsatadi →
    BE GOING TO.
    → AM GOING TO DO
    ('I'LL DO that soon' ham to'g'ri —
     ayni damdagi qaror sifatida.)

14  'I ... (want) to go to the Rastro flea
     market.'
    'want' — HIS fe'li, Continuous
    BO'LMAYDI → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    → WANT

15  '... (you/try) paella YET?'
    KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU TRIED

16  'I ... (go) to Lhardy restaurant LAST
     NIGHT.'
    KALIT: 'LAST NIGHT' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → WENT

17  'What ... (you/do) TONIGHT?'
    Kelajakdagi REJA →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → ARE YOU DOING

18  'I ... (go) to the opera.'
    Aniq REJA (chipta bor) →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → AM GOING


⚠ 10-BAND HAQIDA MUHIM IZOH:

  Qavsda '(you/go)' yozilgan, lekin javob
  'HAVE YOU BEEN' bo'ladi.

  Nega? Chunki:
     'Have you GONE to Palacio Real?'

exercises.explanationUz:
MATNNING TO'LIQ NUSXASI:

  TIPPING IN AMERICA

  Americans take tipping more seriously than
  any other nationality, and of all Americans,
  no one takes tipping as seriously as hotel
  bellboys do.

  Tip your bellboy generously, and you'll have
  the perfect holiday. Don't tip him, and
  you'll have the worst holiday of your life!

  Guests who don't tip well at hotels often
  find that the heating in their room
  'accidentally' stops working in the middle of
  winter, or that they receive strange phone
  calls in the middle of the night. Sometimes
  the keys for their room 'disappear' and it
  seems that no one can find the spare keys.

  It's a good idea to tip a bellboy at least $5
  and, for tips of $20 or more, your bellboy
  will be your friend forever. So, anyone who
  is planning to stay in an American hotel
  should remember — bellboys can make sure you
  have the holiday of your dreams ... or they
  can make your visit a nightmare!


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  AMERIKADA ChOYChAQA BERISh

  Amerikaliklar choychaqa berishga boshqa
  har qanday millatdan ko'ra jiddiyroq
  qaraydi, va barcha amerikaliklar orasida
  hech kim mehmonxona xizmatchilaridek
  jiddiy qaramaydi.

  Xizmatchiga saxiylik bilan choychaqa
  bering — mukammal ta'til o'tkazasiz.
  Bermang — umringizdagi eng yomon ta'til
  bo'ladi!

  Mehmonxonada yaxshi choychaqa bermaydigan
  mehmonlar ko'pincha xonasidagi isitish
  qishning o'rtasida 'tasodifan' ishlashdan
  to'xtaganini yoki tunning yarmida g'alati
  telefon qo'ng'iroqlari kelayotganini
  sezishadi. Ba'zan xona kalitlari
  'yo'qoladi' va hech kim zaxira kalitlarni
  topa olmaydiganday tuyuladi.

  Xizmatchiga kamida 5 dollar berish yaxshi
  fikr, 20 dollar va undan ko'p bo'lsa,
  xizmatchi umrbod do'stingizga aylanadi.
  Shunday ekan, Amerika mehmonxonasida
  turishni rejalashtirayotgan har kim shuni
  esda tutsin — xizmatchilar sizga orzudagi
  ta'tilni ham ta'minlay oladi... yoki
  tashrifingizni dahshatli tushga aylantira
  oladi!


QALIN HARFDAGI SO'ZLAR — TUShUNTIRISh
(17b-mashq shuni so'raydi):

  TIPPING = choychaqa berish
     'a tip' = choychaqa (xizmat uchun
     qo'shimcha pul)
     'to tip somebody' = choychaqa bermoq

  NATIONALITY = millat
     'What nationality are you?'
     = Millatingiz nima?

  GENEROUSLY = saxiylik bilan
     'generous' = saxiy
     'generosity' = saxiylik

  GUESTS = mehmonlar
     Mehmonxonada — turgan odamlar.

  HEATING = isitish (tizimi)
     'to heat' = isitmoq
     'a heater' = isitgich

  'ACCIDENTALLY' = tasodifan
     Qo'shtirnoq ichida, chunki ASLIDA
     tasodif emas — ataylab qilingan!

  RECEIVE = olmoq (qabul qilmoq)
     'receive a phone call' = qo'ng'iroq olmoq
     Yozilishi: rec-EI-ve (I dan oldin E)

  'DISAPPEAR' = yo'qolmoq
     dis + appear (appear = paydo bo'lmoq)
     Qo'shtirnoq ichida — o'z-o'zidan
     yo'qolmagan!

  SPARE = zaxira, qo'shimcha
     'spare keys' = zaxira kalitlar
     'a spare room' = mehmon xonasi

  NIGHTMARE = dahshatli tush, kabus
     night + mare (qadimgi so'z)
     'to have a nightmare' = qo'rqinchli
     tush ko'rmoq


⚠ DIQQAT — QO'ShTIRNOQLARNING MA'NOSI:

  Matnda IKKI so'z qo'shtirnoq ichida:
     'accidentally'  va  'disappear'

  Bu — KINOYA. Yozuvchi aslida bunday
  emasligini bildiryapti:
     isitish 'tasodifan' to'xtamaydi —
     xizmatchi ataylab o'chirib qo'yadi;
     kalitlar 'yo'qolmaydi' — yashiriladi.

  Ingliz tilida qo'shtirnoq shu maqsadda
  ko'p ishlatiladi.


GRAMMATIK QURILMALAR:

  1) 'as ... as' — TENGLIK:
     'no one takes tipping AS SERIOUSLY AS
      hotel bellboys do'
     = hech kim xizmatchilarchalik jiddiy
       qaramaydi

  2) 'more ... than' — QIYOS:
     'Americans take tipping MORE SERIOUSLY
      THAN any other nationality'

  3) BUYRUQ + AND + natija:
     'TIP your bellboy generously, AND you'll
      have the perfect holiday.'
     'DON'T TIP him, AND you'll have the worst
      holiday.'

     DIQQAT: bu yerda 'and' — 'shunda'
     ma'nosida (Unit 14 dagi 'or' = 'aks
     holda' ning teskarisi).

  4) 'WHO' bilan ergash gap:
     'Guests WHO don't tip well ...'
     'anyone WHO is planning to stay ...'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to tip / a tip = choychaqa bermoq / choychaqa
  seriously      = jiddiy
  a nationality  = millat
  a bellboy      = mehmonxona xizmatchisi
                   (yuk tashuvchi)
  generously     = saxiylik bilan
  perfect        = mukammal
  the worst      = eng yomon
  a guest        = mehmon
  heating        = isitish
  accidentally   = tasodifan
  in the middle of = ... o'rtasida
  to receive     = olmoq
  strange        = g'alati
  to disappear   = yo'qolmoq
  spare          = zaxira
  at least       = kamida
  forever        = umrbod
  to make sure   = ta'minlamoq, ishonch hosil
                   qilmoq
  a nightmare    = dahshatli tush, kabus

      balki 'DISAPPEAR' (yo'qoladi)!

     least ...'

    'It's a good idea to tip a bellboy AT

    B a good or a bad holiday.  ✓
    C a clean or a dirty room.

    'bellboys can MAKE SURE you have the

exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI:
  AFFIRMATIVE (tasdiq) / NEGATIVE (inkor)

Kitob ba'zi kataklarni to'ldirib bergan
(qizil rangda), qolganini o'zingiz
to'ldirasiz.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  TASDIQ (Affirmative):
     I / you            HAVE  cleaned
                        (kitob bergan)
     he / she / it      HAS   cleaned
                        (kitob bergan)
     we / you / they    HAVE  cleaned  ←

  INKOR (Negative):
     I / you            HAVEN'T cleaned
                        (kitob bergan)
     he / she / it      HASN'T  cleaned  ←
     we / you / they    HAVEN'T cleaned  ←


TO'LIQ TUSLANISh:

  TASDIQ:
     I have cleaned          we have cleaned
     you have cleaned        you have cleaned
     he has cleaned          they have cleaned
     she has cleaned
     it has cleaned

  INKOR:
     I haven't cleaned       we haven't cleaned
     you haven't cleaned     you haven't cleaned
     he hasn't cleaned       they haven't cleaned
     she hasn't cleaned
     it hasn't cleaned


OLTIN QOIDA — JUDA ODDIY:

  HAS  →  faqat HE / SHE / IT bilan
  HAVE →  qolgan HAMMASI bilan
          (I, you, we, they)

  Inkor:
     hasn't  = has not
     haven't = have not


YASALIShI:
  HAVE / HAS  +  fe'lning III shakli (V3)

  'clean' — TO'G'RI fe'l, shuning uchun
  V3 = V2 = 'cleaned'.


QISQARTMALAR (og'zaki nutqda):
     I have    →  I'VE
     you have  →  YOU'VE
     he has    →  HE'S
     she has   →  SHE'S
     it has    →  IT'S
     we have   →  WE'VE
     they have →  THEY'VE

  DIQQAT — 'HE'S' IKKI MA'NOLI:
     'He'S cleaned it.'  = he HAS cleaned
     'He'S a doctor.'    = he IS a doctor

  Qaysi ekanini KEYINGI SO'Z aytadi:
     keyin V3 kelsa  →  HAS
     keyin ot/sifat  →  IS


DIQQAT — FE'LNING III ShAKLI (V3):

  TO'G'RI fe'llar: V2 = V3 (ikkalasi ham -ed)
     clean → cleaned → CLEANED
     visit → visited → VISITED
     stay  → stayed  → STAYED

  NOTO'G'RI fe'llar: V3 boshqa bo'lishi
  mumkin
     see   → saw   → SEEN
     be    → was   → BEEN
     do    → did   → DONE
     go    → went  → GONE
     eat   → ate   → EATEN
     ride  → rode  → RIDDEN
     drive → drove → DRIVEN
     fly   → flew  → FLOWN

  Ba'zilarida V2 = V3:
     buy   → bought → BOUGHT
     meet  → met    → MET
     have  → had    → HAD


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  affirmative     = tasdiq shakli
  negative        = inkor shakli
  past participle = fe'lning III shakli
  to clean        = tozalamoq

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect - Past Simple (the rules)
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect - Past Simple (qoidalar)
exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — ENG MUHIM QOIDA


KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We form the PRESENT PERFECT with HAVE/HAS
    and the PAST PARTICIPLE of the main verb.'

 • 'We use the PRESENT PERFECT to talk about an
    action which happened in the past,
    WITHOUT SAYING WHEN it happened.'
      He's BEEN to Spain.
      (We don't know WHEN he went to Spain.)

 • 'We use the PAST SIMPLE to talk about an
    action which happened at a DEFINITE TIME
    in the past.'
      He WENT to Spain LAST MONTH.
      (When did he go to Spain? Last month —
       definite time.)

 • 'TIME ADVERBS used with the PRESENT PERFECT:
    ever, just, yet, already, for, since, etc.'

 • 'TIME ADVERBS used with the PAST SIMPLE:
    yesterday, two/three/etc days/months/etc
    ago, last Monday/week/month, etc.'


O'ZBEKChA — BUTUN UNITNING KALITI:

  VAQT AYTILMAGAN  →  PRESENT PERFECT
     'He's been to Spain.'
     (Qachon borgani NOMA'LUM)

  VAQT AYTILGAN    →  PAST SIMPLE
     'He went to Spain last month.'
     (Qachon? — o'tgan oyda)


VAQT RAVIShLARI — IKKI RO'YXAT:

  PRESENT PERFECT bilan:
     ever      (hech qachon — savolda)
     never     (hech qachon — inkorda)
     just      (hozirgina)
     yet       (hali)
     already   (allaqachon)
     for       (... davomida)
     since     (... dan beri)

  PAST SIMPLE bilan:
     yesterday        (kecha)
     two days ago     (ikki kun oldin)
     three months ago (uch oy oldin)
     last Monday      (o'tgan dushanba)
     last week        (o'tgan hafta)
     last month       (o'tgan oy)
     in 2010          (2010-yilda)


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:
  'I have seen him YESTERDAY.'      ✗
  'I SAW him yesterday.'            ✓

  'I have gone to Spain LAST MONTH.' ✗
  'I WENT to Spain last month.'      ✓

  ANIQ VAQT ravishi bo'lsa, Present Perfect
  ISHLATILMAYDI!


DIQQAT — 'AGO' va 'FOR' FARQI:
  'two days AGO'  → Past Simple
     'I saw him two days ago.'
  'FOR two days'  → Present Perfect
     'I have been here for two days.'

  Ikkalasi ham 'ikki kun' haqida, lekin:
     ago = O'TMISHDAGI nuqta
     for = HOZIRGACHA davom etgan muddat


NEGA BU FARQ MUHIM:

  'He WENT to Spain.'
     → borgan va (ehtimol) qaytgan; o'tmish
       tugagan

  'He HAS BEEN to Spain.'
     → tajribasi bor; hozirga aloqador

  'He HAS GONE to Spain.'
     → hali u yerda!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  past participle = fe'lning III shakli
  the main verb   = asosiy fe'l
  an action       = harakat
  definite time   = aniq vaqt
  a time adverb   = vaqt ravishi

105-BETDAGI XATDAN:


JEK QILGAN UCh ISh (HAS DONE):

 1  He HAS VISITED the Khan al-Khalili bazaar.
    Xatdan: 'I've already VISITED the Khan
    al-Khalili bazaar.'

 2  He HAS SEEN the Pyramids and the Sphinx.
    Xatdan: 'I have also SEEN the Pyramids and
    the Sphinx at Giza.'

 3  He HAS BEEN TO a traditional restaurant.
    Xatdan: 'I've BEEN TO a traditional
    restaurant.'


JEK QILMAGAN IKKI ISh (HASN'T DONE):

 1  He HASN'T BEEN on a boat trip down the
    River Nile.
    Xatdan: 'I HAVEN'T BEEN on a boat trip down
    the River Nile yet.'

 2  He HASN'T VISITED the Egyptian Museum.
    Xatdan: 'and I HAVEN'T VISITED the Egyptian
    Museum.'


⚠ DIQQAT — OLMOSh VA FE'L O'ZGARADI:

  Xatda BIRINChI shaxs:
     'I HAVE visited ...'
     'I HAVEN'T been ...'

  Javobda UChINChI shaxs:
     'HE HAS visited ...'
     'HE HASN'T been ...'

  Ya'ni 'have' → 'HAS' ga o'zgaradi
  (chunki 'he' — III shaxs birlik).

  Bu — mashqning eng ko'p unutiladigan qismi!


QANDAY TOPILADI — XATDA IKKI GURUH:

  Xatning 2-XATBOShISI — QILGAN ishlar
  (hammasi TASDIQ Present Perfect)

  Xatning 3-XATBOShISI — QILMAGAN ishlar
  ('There are a lot of things I HAVEN'T
    DONE YET' bilan boshlanadi)

  Kitob ataylab shunday tuzgan.


QO'ShIMChA — XATDAGI PAST SIMPLE GAPLAR
(bular bu mashqqa KIRMAYDI):
     'We visited it on Tuesday.'
     'I bought some souvenirs.'
     'I saw them yesterday.'
     'I even rode a camel.'
     'Abdullah took me there last night.'
     'I tried couscous and falafel.'

  Bular Past Simple da, chunki ANIQ VAQT
  aytilgan yoki tafsilot berilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to find      = topmoq
  three things = uchta narsa/ish

     'HAVE you been ...?'  →  'Yes, I HAVE.'
     'HAS he been ...?'    →  'Yes, he HAS.'

  Savol qaysi so'z bilan boshlansa, javobda
  ham o'sha so'z qoladi.


SO'ROQ ShAKLI QANDAY YASALADI:

  HAVE / HAS  +  EGA  +  V3  + ... ?

     Have you been to Turkey?
     Has he been to Turkey?
     Have they visited Spain?

  DIQQAT: 'DO' KERAK EMAS!
     'Have you been ...?'    ✓
     'DO you have been ...?' ✗


QISQA JAVOBDA ASOSIY FE'L TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     'Yes, I have.'              ✓
     'Yes, I have been.'         (ortiqcha)
     'Yes, I have been to Turkey.' (juda
                                    ortiqcha)

  Faqat 'have/has' qoladi.


DIQQAT — TO'LIQ ShAKL QISQA JAVOBDA:
  IJOBIY javobda QISQARTMA IShLATILMAYDI:
     'Yes, I HAVE.'   ✓
     'Yes, I'VE.'     ✗

  SALBIY javobda esa qisqartma odatiy:
     'No, I HAVEN'T.' ✓
     'No, I have not.' ✓ (rasmiyroq)

  Bu — barcha qisqa javoblarga taalluqli
  qoida ('Yes, I AM' ✓ / 'Yes, I'M' ✗).


SAVOL SO'ZI BILAN — QISQA JAVOB BO'LMAYDI:
  'WHERE have you been?'
     → 'To Turkey.' (qisqa javob emas,
        to'ldiruvchi)
  'HOW LONG have you been here?'
     → 'Since Monday.'

  Faqat HA/YO'Q savollariga qisqa javob
  beriladi.


BOG'LIQLIK — 105-BETDAGI DIALOG:
     SA: 'HAS Jack VISITED the bazaar?'
     SB: 'Yes, he HAS.'

  Aynan shu qoida ishlatilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  interrogative = so'roq shakli
  a short answer = qisqa javob
  Turkey        = Turkiya

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect + Ever/Never
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect + Ever/Never
exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use EVER in QUESTIONS and STATEMENTS.'
      Have you EVER visited Brazil?
      Brazil is the best place I've EVER
      visited.

 • 'We use NEVER in STATEMENTS.'
      I've NEVER visited Cyprus.
      I haven't visited Cyprus.


'EVER' NING IKKI IShLATILIShI:

  1) SAVOLDA — 'hech qachon ...ganmisiz?'
        'Have you EVER visited Brazil?'
        'Have you EVER been to Egypt?'

     Bu yerda 'ever' = umr davomida biror
     marta.

  2) USTUN DARAJA bilan — 'ko'rgan eng ...'
        'Brazil is the BEST place I've EVER
         visited.'
        'It's the MOST beautiful city I've EVER
         seen.'

     Qolip: the + [ustun daraja] + ... +
            I've EVER + V3

     DIQQAT: bu qurilmada 'ever' TASDIQ
     gapda keladi, lekin baribir Present
     Perfect bilan.


'NEVER' — FAQAT TASDIQ ShAKLDA:

     'I've NEVER visited Cyprus.'  ✓
     'I haven't NEVER visited.'    ✗ XATO!

  'never' O'ZI INKOR ma'noni beradi,
  shuning uchun 'haven't' bilan BIRGA
  ishlatilmaydi.

  Ikki xil aytish mumkin:
     'I've NEVER visited Cyprus.'   (never)
     'I HAVEN'T visited Cyprus.'    (haven't)

  Ma'nosi bir xil, lekin 'never' KUCHLIROQ.


'EVER' va 'NEVER' QAYERDA TURADI:

  'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
     Have you EVER visited ...?
     I've NEVER visited ...
     I've EVER visited ...

  'Have you visited EVER?' — XATO.


JAVOB BERISh:

  'Have you ever been to Brazil?'
     Yes, I have.
     No, I haven't.  /  No, I've never been
                        there.


DIQQAT — 'EVER' TASDIQ ODDIY GAPDA
IShLATILMAYDI:
     'I have ever been to Spain.'  ✗
     'I have been to Spain.'       ✓

  'ever' faqat:
     • savolda
     • ustun daraja qurilmasida
     • inkorda ('I haven't ever ...' — bu
       'I've never ...' bilan bir xil)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  ever      = hech qachon (savolda)
  never     = hech qachon (inkor ma'noda)
  a statement = darak gap
  Brazil    = Braziliya
  Cyprus    = Kipr

lekin 'never' KUCHLIROQ.

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N MAMLAKAT:
  Australia, Turkey, Greece, Mexico, Italy,
  Canada, Spain, Poland, Brazil, China


KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:

  'I've BEEN TO Spain. It's the best country
   I've EVER visited.'

  'I've NEVER been to China.'


IKKI QOLIP:

  BORGAN bo'lsangiz:
     'I've been to [mamlakat].'
     (+ ixtiyoriy baho: 'It's the best country
        I've ever visited.')

  BORMAGAN bo'lsangiz:
     'I've never been to [mamlakat].'


DIQQAT — BU ShAXSIY MAShQ:
  Javob har kimda BOSHQA bo'ladi — o'z
  tajribangizga qarab.

  Quyida NAMUNA javoblar berilgan
  (o'zbekistonlik o'quvchi uchun eng
  ehtimolli variant).


NAMUNA JAVOBLAR (10 mamlakat):

 1  I've never been to Australia.
 2  I've been to Turkey. It's the most
    beautiful country I've ever visited.
 3  I've never been to Greece.
 4  I've never been to Mexico.
 5  I've never been to Italy.
 6  I've never been to Canada.
 7  I've never been to Spain.
 8  I've never been to Poland.
 9  I've never been to Brazil.
10  I've never been to China.

  (Bu — faqat namuna. O'z javobingizni
   yozing!)


USTUN DARAJA QOLIPI — BATAFSIL:

  'It's the BEST country I've EVER visited.'

  Boshqa variantlar:
     'It's the MOST BEAUTIFUL country I've
      ever visited.'
     'It's the MOST INTERESTING place I've
      ever seen.'
     'It's the BIGGEST city I've ever been to.'

  Qolip:
     It's the + [USTUN DARAJA] + [ot] +
     I've EVER + [V3].

  DIQQAT: 'that' tushirib qoldirilgan —
  to'liq shakli:
     'the best country THAT I've ever visited'


DIQQAT — 'BEEN TO' PREDLOG:
  'I've been TO Spain.'  ✓
  'I've been IN Spain.'  — boshqa ma'no
                           (ichkarida bo'lish)
  'I've been Spain.'     ✗


DIQQAT — MAMLAKAT NOMLARIDA ARTIKL:
  Ro'yxatdagi 10 mamlakatning HAMMASI
  ARTIKLSIZ:
     Australia, Turkey, Greece, Mexico, Italy,
     Canada, Spain, Poland, Brazil, China

  ISTISNOLAR (bu ro'yxatda yo'q):
     the USA, the UK, the Netherlands,
     the Philippines

  (Grammar 63-bet, 10-mashq qoidasi.)


DIQQAT — 'NEVER' O'RNI:
  'I've NEVER been to China.'  ✓
  'I never have been ...'      ✗
  'I've been never ...'        ✗

  'never' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Australia = Avstraliya
  Turkey    = Turkiya
  Greece    = Gretsiya
  Mexico    = Meksika
  Italy     = Italiya
  Canada    = Kanada
  Spain     = Ispaniya
  Poland    = Polsha
  Brazil    = Braziliya
  China     = Xitoy

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts and the adjectives in the list to ask and answer questions, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ko'rsatmalar va ro'yxatdagi sifatlardan foydalanib namunalardagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI KO'RSATMA:
  • visit Prague? - last summer
  • ride a camel? - no
  • stay in a big hotel? - last winter
  • eat Chinese food? - last Sunday
  • meet a famous person? - no
  • drive a bus? - no
  • fly in a plane? - a month ago

SIFATLAR:
  exciting, fantastic, amazing, delicious,
  great, awful, horrible, terrible, disgusting


KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:

  SA: Have you EVER VISITED Prague?
  SB: Yes, I HAVE.
  SA: WHEN DID you VISIT Prague?
  SB: Last summer. It was exciting.

  SA: Have you EVER RIDDEN a camel?
  SB: No, I HAVEN'T. I've NEVER RIDDEN a camel.


IKKI QOLIP:

  A) JAVOB 'HA' bo'lsa (vaqt berilgan):
     SA: Have you ever [V3] ...?
     SB: Yes, I have.
     SA: When did you [V1] ...?
     SB: [vaqt]. It was [sifat].

  B) JAVOB 'YO'Q' bo'lsa:
     SA: Have you ever [V3] ...?
     SB: No, I haven't. I've never [V3] ...


BARCHA YETTI DIALOG:

 1  SA: Have you ever VISITED Prague?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you VISIT Prague?
    SB: Last summer. It was EXCITING.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  SA: Have you ever RIDDEN a camel?
    SB: No, I haven't. I've never RIDDEN a
        camel.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 3  SA: Have you ever STAYED in a big hotel?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you STAY in a big hotel?
    SB: Last winter. It was FANTASTIC.

 4  SA: Have you ever EATEN Chinese food?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you EAT Chinese food?
    SB: Last Sunday. It was DELICIOUS.

 5  SA: Have you ever MET a famous person?
    SB: No, I haven't. I've never MET a famous
        person.

 6  SA: Have you ever DRIVEN a bus?
    SB: No, I haven't. I've never DRIVEN a bus.

 7  SA: Have you ever FLOWN in a plane?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you FLY in a plane?
    SB: A month ago. It was AMAZING.


⚠ ENG MUHIM QISM — III ShAKL (V3):

  Savolda V3, javobda V1 ishlatiladi!

  SAVOL (Present Perfect)   JAVOB (Past Simple)
  ─────────────────────     ──────────────────
  Have you ever VISITED?    When did you VISIT?
  Have you ever RIDDEN?     (—)
  Have you ever STAYED?     When did you STAY?
  Have you ever EATEN?      When did you EAT?
  Have you ever MET?        (—)
  Have you ever DRIVEN?     (—)
  Have you ever FLOWN?      When did you FLY?

  DIQQAT: 'did' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY
  shaklda!
     'When did you EAT?'    ✓
     'When did you ATE?'    ✗
     'When did you EATEN?'  ✗


UCh ASOSIY ShAKL (mashqdagi fe'llar):

  visit  →  visited  →  VISITED   (to'g'ri)
  ride   →  rode     →  RIDDEN
  stay   →  stayed   →  STAYED    (to'g'ri)
  eat    →  ate      →  EATEN
  meet   →  met      →  MET
  drive  →  drove    →  DRIVEN
  fly    →  flew     →  FLOWN

  DIQQAT: 'ridden', 'eaten', 'driven',
  'flown' — bularni YODLASh kerak.


SIFATLAR IKKI GURUHDA:

  IJOBIY:
     exciting  (hayajonli)
     fantastic (ajoyib)
     amazing   (hayratlanarli)
     delicious (juda mazali — faqat OVQAT)
     great     (zo'r)

  SALBIY:
     awful      (juda yomon)
     horrible   (dahshatli)
     terrible   (dahshatli)
     disgusting (jirkanch — ko'pincha OVQAT)

  DIQQAT: 'delicious' va 'disgusting'
  asosan OVQAT haqida ishlatiladi, shuning
  uchun 4-bandga (Chinese food) mos keladi.


DIQQAT — 'FLY IN A PLANE':
  'to fly IN a plane' = samolyotda uchmoq
  ('to fly ON a plane' ham uchraydi,
   lekin 'in' standart)


DIQQAT — 'A MONTH AGO':
  'a month AGO' — PAST SIMPLE ko'rsatkichi.
  Shuning uchun javob: 'A month ago.'
  va 'It WAS amazing.'

  DIQQAT: 'ago' bilan Present Perfect
  ISHLATILMAYDI!


RASM:
  Otliq bronza haykal — Pragadagi mashhur
  Avliyo Vatslav haykali (Wenceslas Square).
  1-bandga ('visit Prague') ishora.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Prague       = Praga (Chexiya poytaxti)
  a famous person = mashhur odam
  to fly       = uchmoq (fly → flew → FLOWN)
  exciting     = hayajonli
  awful        = juda yomon
  terrible     = dahshatli

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect + Yet/Already
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect + Yet/Already
exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use ALREADY in POSITIVE STATEMENTS.'
 • 'We use YET in QUESTIONS and NEGATIVES.'

 MISOLLAR:
    Have you packed your suitcase YET?
    No, I haven't. I haven't packed it YET.
    Yes, I have. I've ALREADY packed it.


QISQA JADVAL:

  ALREADY  →  TASDIQ gapda
              'I've ALREADY packed it.'

  YET      →  SAVOLDA
              'Have you packed it YET?'
           →  INKORDA
              'I haven't packed it YET.'


QAYERDA TURADI:

  ALREADY — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
     'I've ALREADY packed it.'
     'She has ALREADY left.'

     (Ba'zan gap oxirida ham keladi, lekin
      o'rtada turgani standart.)

  YET — GAP OXIRIDA:
     'Have you packed it YET?'
     'I haven't packed it YET.'

     'Have you YET packed it?' — XATO.


MA'NOLARI:

  ALREADY = allaqachon
     Kutilganidan ERTAROQ bo'lgan ish.
     'I've already packed.' = kutmagan
     edingiz, lekin men allaqachon
     yig'ib bo'ldim.

  YET = hali
     Kutilayotgan, lekin HALI bo'lmagan ish.
     'I haven't packed yet.' = hali
     yig'madim (lekin yig'ishim kerak).

  Ya'ni 'yet' KUTILAYOTGAN ishni bildiradi.


DIQQAT — 'YET' va 'STILL':
  'I haven't packed YET.'
     = hali yig'madim (neytral)
  'I STILL haven't packed.'
     = hali ham yig'madim (sabrsizlik,
       ajablanish)

  'still' — 'haven't' dan OLDIN.


DIQQAT — 'ALREADY' SAVOLDA:
  Ba'zan savolda ham ishlatiladi, lekin
  AJABLANISH ma'nosida:
     'Have you ALREADY packed?'
     = Allaqachon yig'ib bo'ldingizmi?
       (Shunchalik tezmi?)

  Oddiy savolda esa 'yet':
     'Have you packed YET?'


BOG'LIQLIK — 105-BETDAGI XAT:
  'I've ALREADY visited the bazaar.'
     (tasdiq)
  'I haven't been on a boat trip YET.'
     (inkor)
  'There are a lot of things I haven't
   done YET.'
     (inkor)

  Jekning xati bu qoidani aynan ishlatgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  already     = allaqachon
  yet         = hali
  to pack     = (yukni) yig'moq
  a suitcase  = chamadon
  a positive statement = tasdiq gap

exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use JUST in statements to show that an
    action finished only A FEW MINUTES EARLIER.'

 MISOL:
    A: Have you packed your suitcase yet?
    B: Yes, I've JUST packed it.


'JUST' NING MA'NOSI:
  'just' = hozirgina, endigina

  Harakat BIR NECHA DAQIQA oldin tugagan.

     'I've JUST arrived.'    = hozirgina keldim
     'She's JUST left.'      = u endigina ketdi
     'We've JUST finished.'  = endigina
                               tugatdik


QAYERDA TURADI:
  'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
     'I've JUST packed it.'  ✓
     'I've packed it JUST.'  ✗
     'JUST I've packed it.'  ✗

  Xuddi 'already' kabi.


UCh RAVIShNI SOLIShTIRING:

  JUST     — hozirgina (bir necha daqiqa
             oldin)
             'I've just packed it.'

  ALREADY  — allaqachon (kutilganidan
             ertaroq)
             'I've already packed it.'

  YET      — hali (kutilayotgan, lekin hali
             bo'lmagan)
             'I haven't packed it yet.'

  Hammasi Present Perfect bilan.
  JUST va ALREADY — TASDIQDA, o'rtada.
  YET — SAVOL/INKORDA, gap oxirida.


DIQQAT — 'JUST' NING BOShQA MA'NOLARI:
  'just' — faqat (only)
     'I have JUST one question.'
  'just' — aynan
     'That's JUST what I wanted.'
  'just' — shunchaki
     'The food was JUST delicious.'
     (105-betdagi Jekning xatidan!)

  Present Perfect bilan esa 'hozirgina'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  just    = hozirgina, endigina
  earlier = oldinroq
  to pack = (yukni) yig'moq

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect + For/Since
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect + For/Since
exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use FOR to express DURATION.'
      I've been here FOR five days.

 • 'We use SINCE to state a STARTING POINT.'
      I've been here SINCE Monday.


ENG ODDIY FARQ:

  FOR    +  QANChA VAQT (davomiylik)
            for five days
            for two years
            for a long time
            for ten minutes

  SINCE  +  QAChONDAN BERI (boshlanish nuqtasi)
            since Monday
            since 1987
            since last week
            since I was a child


QANDAY ESLAB QOLISh:

  Savol bering: 'QANChA VAQT?' yoki
  'QAChONDAN BERI?'

     'five days'  → qancha vaqt?  → FOR
     'Monday'     → qachondan?    → SINCE
     'two years'  → qancha vaqt?  → FOR
     '1987'       → qachondan?    → SINCE

  Ya'ni:
     RAQAM + vaqt birligi  →  FOR
     ANIQ NUQTA (kun, sana, yil)  →  SINCE


MISOLLAR YONMA-YON:

  FOR                    SINCE
  ─────────────────      ──────────────────
  for three days         since Monday
  for two years          since 2010
  for a week             since last week
  for ten minutes        since 5 o'clock
  for a long time        since I came here
  for ages               since my birthday

  DIQQAT — 'a week' va 'last week':
     FOR a week    = bir hafta davomida
     SINCE last week = o'tgan haftadan beri


DIQQAT — 'SINCE' + TO'LIQ GAP:
  'since' dan keyin GAP ham kelishi mumkin:
     'I've been here SINCE I ARRIVED.'
     'I haven't seen him SINCE HE LEFT.'

  Bunda gap PAST SIMPLE da bo'ladi.


IKKALASI HAM PRESENT PERFECT BILAN:
  'I've been here for five days.'  ✓
  'I am here for five days.'  — boshqa ma'no
                                (reja)
  'I was here for five days.' — o'tmish
                                (tugagan)

  Present Perfect — harakat HALI DAVOM
  etayotganini ko'rsatadi.


DIQQAT — 'FOR' TUShIRIB QOLDIRILIShI MUMKIN:
  'I've been here (for) five days.'
  Og'zaki nutqda 'for' ba'zan tushiriladi.
  'since' esa HECH QAChON tushirilmaydi.


DIQQAT — 'AGO' BILAN ADAShTIRMANG:
  'five days AGO'  →  PAST SIMPLE
     'I arrived five days ago.'
  'FOR five days'  →  PRESENT PERFECT
     'I've been here for five days.'

  Ikkalasi ham 'besh kun' haqida, lekin
  zamonlari BOSHQA.


BOG'LIQLIK — 105-BETDAGI XAT:
  'I've been here SINCE MONDAY.'
  Jekning xati aynan shu qurilmani
  ishlatgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  duration       = davomiylik
  a starting point = boshlanish nuqtasi
  for            = ... davomida
  since          = ... dan beri

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  He/be in Cairo/Friday
    → He HAS BEEN in Cairo SINCE Friday.
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  He/live in Rome/three years
    → He HAS LIVED in Rome FOR three years.

 3  I/not see/Jane/ten years
    → I HAVEN'T SEEN Jane FOR ten years.

 4  I/not travel/by plane/1987
    → I HAVEN'T TRAVELLED by plane SINCE 1987.

 5  They/be/on holiday/last Monday
    → They HAVE BEEN on holiday SINCE last
      Monday.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  U juma kunidan beri Qohirada.
 2  U uch yildan beri Rimda yashaydi.
 3  Jeynni o'n yildan beri ko'rmaganman.
 4  1987-yildan beri samolyotda
    sayohat qilmaganman.
 5  Ular o'tgan dushanbadan beri ta'tilda.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — OXIRGI QISMGA QARANG:

  1  'Friday'      → KUN → SINCE
  2  'three years' → QANCHA VAQT → FOR
  3  'ten years'   → QANCHA VAQT → FOR
  4  '1987'        → YIL → SINCE
  5  'last Monday' → ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE

  Ya'ni:
     FOR — 2, 3 (raqam + vaqt birligi)
     SINCE — 1, 4, 5 (kun, yil, aniq nuqta)


QISQA YOZUVNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh —
NIMA QO'ShILADI:

  1) HAVE / HAS
     ega III shaxs birlik bo'lsa → HAS
     (1, 2-bandlar: 'He')
     qolganlarida → HAVE
     (3, 4-bandlar: 'I'; 5-band: 'They')

  2) FE'LNING III ShAKLI (V3)
     be    → BEEN
     live  → LIVED
     see   → SEEN
     travel → TRAVELLED

  3) 'NOT' bo'lsa → HAVEN'T / HASN'T
     (3, 4-bandlar)

  4) FOR yoki SINCE


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'He/be in Cairo/Friday'
    ega 'He' → HAS
    be → BEEN
    'Friday' → kun → SINCE
    → 'He HAS BEEN in Cairo SINCE Friday.'

 2  'He/live in Rome/three years'
    ega 'He' → HAS
    live → LIVED (to'g'ri fe'l)
    'three years' → davomiylik → FOR
    → 'He HAS LIVED in Rome FOR three years.'

 3  'I/not see/Jane/ten years'
    ega 'I' → HAVE, 'not' bor → HAVEN'T
    see → SEEN
    'ten years' → davomiylik → FOR
    → 'I HAVEN'T SEEN Jane FOR ten years.'

 4  'I/not travel/by plane/1987'
    ega 'I' → HAVEN'T
    travel → TRAVELLED
       (britancha: L IKKILANADI!)
    '1987' → yil → SINCE
    → 'I HAVEN'T TRAVELLED by plane SINCE
       1987.'

 5  'They/be/on holiday/last Monday'
    ega 'They' → HAVE
    be → BEEN
    'last Monday' → aniq nuqta → SINCE
    → 'They HAVE BEEN on holiday SINCE last
       Monday.'


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'TRAVELLED':
  BRITANCHA:  travel → TRAVELLED (LL)
  AMERIKACHA: travel → TRAVELED  (L)

  Enterprise — britancha kitob, shuning uchun
  IKKI 'L'.

  Shu kabi: cancel → cancelled,
  quarrel → quarrelled.


DIQQAT — 3 va 4-BANDLAR INKORDA:
  'I HAVEN'T seen Jane FOR ten years.'
  = o'n yildan beri ko'rmadim (va hozir ham
    ko'rmayapman)

  INKOR gapda ham 'for/since' ishlatiladi.


DIQQAT — 'BY PLANE':
  'travel BY plane / BY car / BY train / BY
   bus'
  Transport vositasi 'BY' bilan, ARTIKLSIZ.

  ISTISNO: 'ON FOOT' (piyoda) — 'by foot'
  XATO.


DIQQAT — 'ON HOLIDAY':
  'They have been ON HOLIDAY.'
  'on holiday' — turg'un ibora, artiklsiz.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to expand    = kengaytirmoq
  notes        = qisqa yozuvlar
  Rome         = Rim
  to travel    = sayohat qilmoq
  by plane     = samolyotda
  on holiday   = ta'tilda

exercises.explanationUz:
JADVALNING TO'RT USTUNI:
  HAS  |  WHEN  |  WHAT IT WAS LIKE  |
  WHAT HE DID THERE

Kitob BIRINCHI qatorni to'ldirib bergan
(namuna).


TO'LIQ JADVAL:

 ┌────────────────┬──────────┬─────────────┬──────────────┐
 │ HAS            │ WHEN     │ WHAT IT WAS │ WHAT HE DID  │
 │                │          │ LIKE        │ THERE        │
 ├────────────────┼──────────┼─────────────┼──────────────┤
 │ visited the    │ Tuesday  │ noisy &     │ bought       │
 │ Khan al-Khalili│          │ crowded     │ souvenirs    │
 │ bazaar         │          │             │  (NAMUNA)    │
 ├────────────────┼──────────┼─────────────┼──────────────┤
 │ seen the       │ yesterday│ amazing     │ rode a camel │
 │ Pyramids and   │          │             │              │
 │ the Sphinx     │          │             │              │
 ├────────────────┼──────────┼─────────────┼──────────────┤
 │ been to a      │ last     │ fantastic   │ tried        │
 │ traditional    │ night    │ (food was   │ couscous and │
 │ restaurant     │          │ delicious)  │ falafel      │
 └────────────────┴──────────┴─────────────┴──────────────┘


HAR USTUN QAYERDAN OLINADI:

  HAS  →  Present Perfect gaplaridan
     'I've already VISITED the bazaar'
     'I have also SEEN the Pyramids'
     'I've BEEN TO a traditional restaurant'

  WHEN →  Past Simple gaplaridagi VAQTDAN
     'We visited it ON TUESDAY'
     'I saw them YESTERDAY'
     'Abdullah took me there LAST NIGHT'

  WHAT IT WAS LIKE →  SIFATLARDAN
     'how NOISY AND CROWDED it was'
     'They were AMAZING'
     'The place was FANTASTIC'

  WHAT HE DID THERE →  qo'shimcha
  harakatlardan
     'I BOUGHT some souvenirs'
     'I even RODE A CAMEL'
     'I TRIED couscous and falafel'


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA DIALOG:

  SA: HAS Jack VISITED the Khan al-Khalili
      bazaar?
  SB: Yes, he HAS.
  SA: WHEN DID he VISIT it?
  SB: On Tuesday.
  SA: What WAS it LIKE?
  SB: It WAS noisy and crowded.
  SA: What DID he DO there?
  SB: He BOUGHT some souvenirs.


⚠ ENG MUHIM GRAMMATIK DARS —
ZAMON ALMAShUVI:

  1-savol:  'HAS Jack VISITED ...?'
            → PRESENT PERFECT
            (vaqt aytilmagan)
  Javob:    'Yes, he HAS.'

  2-savol:  'WHEN DID he VISIT it?'
            → PAST SIMPLE
            ('when' — ANIQ vaqt so'ralyapti!)
  Javob:    'On Tuesday.'

  Ya'ni birinchi savol Present Perfect da,
  lekin 'WHEN' so'ralishi bilan zamon
  PAST SIMPLE ga o'tadi.

  BU — Unit 15 ning eng muhim qoidasi:
     'Has he visited?' ✓ (vaqt yo'q)
     'When HAS he visited?' ✗ XATO
     'When DID he VISIT?'  ✓


QOLGAN IKKI QATOR UChUN TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

  SA: Has Jack seen the Pyramids and the
      Sphinx?
  SB: Yes, he has.
  SA: When did he see them?
  SB: Yesterday.
  SA: What were they like?
  SB: They were amazing.
  SA: What did he do there?
  SB: He rode a camel.

  SA: Has Jack been to a traditional
      restaurant?
  SB: Yes, he has.
  SA: When did he go there?
  SB: Last night.
  SA: What was it like?
  SB: It was fantastic and the food was
      delicious.
  SA: What did he do there?
  SB: He tried couscous and falafel.


DIQQAT — 'WHAT WAS IT LIKE?' va
'WHAT WERE THEY LIKE?':
  Ega BIRLIK bo'lsa   →  'What WAS IT like?'
  Ega KO'PLIK bo'lsa  →  'What WERE THEY like?'

  Ehromlar va Sfenks — KO'PLIK, shuning uchun
  'What WERE THEY like?' va 'They WERE
  amazing.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  crowded    = gavjum
  amazing    = hayratlanarli
  fantastic  = ajoyib
  a souvenir = sovg'a, esdalik

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the three short dialogues and decide who is: a) making a reservation at a restaurant; b) inviting somebody out; c) buying souvenirs. In pairs, act out the dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Uchta qisqa dialogni tinglang va kim: a) restoranda joy band qilayotganini; b) birovni taklif qilayotganini; c) sovg'a sotib olayotganini aniqlang. Juftlikda dialoglarni sahnalashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — AUDIO ShART EMAS:
  Uchala dialog ham betda TO'LIQ bosilgan.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1-dialog  →  b) inviting somebody out
               (birovni taklif qilish)
  2-dialog  →  c) buying souvenirs
               (sovg'a sotib olish)
  3-dialog  →  a) making a reservation at a
               restaurant
               (restoranda joy band qilish)


1-DIALOG (TO'LIQ) — b) TAKLIF QILISh:

  A: Hello, Rachel. What are you doing
     tonight?
  B: I haven't got any plans. Why?
  A: Well, there's a good film on at the Odeon
     tonight. Would you like to go?
  B: Yes — that would be great!
  A: Okay. I'll pick you up at eight, then.

  Tarjimasi:
  A: Salom, Reychel. Bugun kechqurun nima
     qilyapsan?
  B: Hech qanday rejam yo'q. Nima edi?
  A: Bugun kechqurun Odeonda yaxshi kino bor.
     Borishni xohlaysanmi?
  B: Ha — zo'r bo'lardi!
  A: Yaxshi. Unda sakkizda kelib olib
     ketaman.

  KALIT: 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO GO?' — taklif.


2-DIALOG (TO'LIQ) — c) SOVG'A SOTIB OLISh:

  A: Can I help you?
  B: Yes, please. I'm looking for a gift to
     take home for my brother.
  A: How about this wallet? It's a lovely gift
     for a man.
  B: How much is it?
  A: It's only £10.
  B: Great — I'll take it. I'm sure he'll like
     it.

  Tarjimasi:
  A: Yordam bera olamanmi?
  B: Ha, iltimos. Akamga olib ketish uchun
     sovg'a qidiryapman.
  A: Bu hamyon qanday? Erkak uchun ajoyib
     sovg'a.
  B: Qanchа turadi?
  A: Atigi 10 funt.
  B: Zo'r — olaman. Unga yoqishiga ishonchim
     komil.

  KALIT: 'I'm looking for a GIFT', 'How much
  is it?', 'I'LL TAKE IT' — do'kondagi savdo.


3-DIALOG (TO'LIQ) — a) JOY BAND QILISh:

  A: Hello. I'd like to book a table for
     tonight, please.
  B: Certainly, madam. What time and for how
     many?
  A: A table for two at nine o'clock, please.
  B: That's fine. Could I have your name,
     please?
  A: Powers. Ann Powers.
  B: Thank you, Ms Powers. We'll see you
     tonight.

  Tarjimasi:
  A: Salom. Bugun kechqurunga stol band
     qilmoqchi edim.
  B: Albatta, xonim. Soat nechada va necha
     kishiga?
  A: Soat to'qqizda ikki kishiga stol,
     iltimos.
  B: Yaxshi. Ismingizni ayta olasizmi?
  A: Pauers. Enn Pauers.
  B: Rahmat, Missis Pauers. Bugun kechqurun
     ko'rishguncha.

  KALIT: 'I'd like to BOOK A TABLE' —
  restoranda joy band qilish.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR DIALOGDA BITTA
KALIT IBORA:

  1  'Would you like to go?'   →  TAKLIF (b)
  2  'I'm looking for a gift'  →  XARID (c)
  3  'I'd like to book a table' → BAND QILISh (a)


HAR VAZIYAT UChUN FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  TAKLIF QILISh (inviting somebody out):
     'What are you doing tonight?'
     'Would you like to go?'
     'Yes, that would be great!'
     'I'll pick you up at eight.'

     RAD ETISh:
     'I'd love to, but I can't.'
     'Sorry, I'm busy tonight.'

  XARID QILISh (buying souvenirs):
     'Can I help you?'
     'I'm looking for ...'
     'How about this ...?'
     'How much is it?'
     'I'll take it.'

  JOY BAND QILISh (making a reservation):
     'I'd like to book a table.'
     'What time and for how many?'
     'A table for two at nine o'clock.'
     'Could I have your name, please?'


DIQQAT — 'I'LL TAKE IT':
  'I'LL take it' = olaman (sotib olaman)
  Do'konda qaror qabul qilish shakli.
  WILL — ayni damdagi qaror (Unit 13).


DIQQAT — 'TO PICK SOMEBODY UP':
  'I'll PICK YOU UP at eight.'
  = sakkizda kelib olib ketaman (mashinada)

  Ajraladigan fe'l:
     pick you up  ✓
     pick up you  ✗ (olmosh bilan faqat
                     o'rtada)


DIQQAT — 'MS':
  'Thank you, MS Powers.'
  Ms /mɪz/ — ayolga murojaat, turmush
  qurgan-qurmaganini bildirmaydi.

     Mrs — turmush qurgan ayol
     Miss — turmush qurmagan ayol
     Ms — ikkalasiga ham (zamonaviy, odobli)


DIQQAT — 'CERTAINLY, MADAM':
  Xizmat sohasida odobli murojaat:
     'madam' — ayolga
     'sir' — erkakka


DIQQAT — 'COULD I HAVE ...?':
  'COULD I have your name, please?'
  'could' — 'can' dan ODOBLIROQ
  (Grammar 60-bet).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a reservation   = joy band qilish
  to book a table = stol band qilmoq
  to invite somebody out = birovni taklif
                    qilmoq
  plans           = rejalar
  the Odeon       = Odeon (kinoteatr nomi)
  to pick somebody up = kelib olib ketmoq
  a gift          = sovg'a
  a wallet        = hamyon (erkak)
  How much is it? = Qancha turadi?
  Certainly       = Albatta
  madam / sir     = xonim / janob
  Ms              = ayolga murojaat

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information from Ex. 16 to write the letter Paul wrote to a friend while he was in Madrid.
exercises.instructionUz: 16-mashqdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib, Pol Madridda ekanida do'stiga yozgan xatni yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
MANBA: 107-betdagi 16-mashq dialogi.

POL HAQIDA MA'LUM BO'LGAN NARSALAR:
  • Madridda
  • o'tgan dushanbadan beri shu yerda
  • do'sti Karlos bilan turadi
  • Prado muzeyiga borgan (o'tgan dushanba),
    u yerda go'zal kartinalar ko'rgan
  • Palacio Real'ga borgan (kecha),
    marosim xonalari ulug'vor edi
  • hali xarid qilgani bormagan
  • Rastro bozoriga borishni rejalashtirgan
  • paelya yeb ko'rgan ('Lhardy'
    restoranida, o'tgan kecha)
  • bugun kechqurun Carmen operasiga boradi


TO'LIQ NAMUNA XAT:

  ─────────────────────────────────────────
  Dear Tom,

  Greetings from Madrid! I'm having a
  wonderful time here. I'm staying with my
  friend Carlos and I've been here since last
  Monday.

  I've already visited a lot of places. I've
  been to the Prado Museum — I went there last
  Monday and I saw some beautiful paintings.
  I've also been to Palacio Real. I went there
  yesterday and the state rooms were
  magnificent. Last night I went to a
  restaurant called 'Lhardy' with some friends
  and I tried paella. The food was just
  delicious!

  I haven't been shopping yet, but I'm going
  to go to the Rastro flea market soon to buy
  some souvenirs. Tonight I'm going to the
  opera to see Carmen.

  Madrid is a fascinating city — you must
  visit it one day!

                            Best wishes,
                            Paul
  ─────────────────────────────────────────


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Tom,

  Madriddan salom! Bu yerda ajoyib vaqt
  o'tkazyapman. Do'stim Karlos bilan turibman
  va o'tgan dushanbadan beri shu yerdaman.

  Allaqachon ko'p joylarga bordim. Prado
  muzeyiga borganman — u yerga o'tgan dushanba
  kuni bordim va bir necha go'zal kartina
  ko'rdim. Palacio Real'ga ham borganman.
  U yerga kecha bordim, marosim xonalari
  ulug'vor edi. O'tgan kecha do'stlarim bilan
  'Lhardy' restoraniga borib, paelya yeb
  ko'rdim. Ovqat juda mazali edi!

  Hali xarid qilgani bormadim, lekin tez orada
  sovg'a olish uchun Rastro bozoriga boraman.
  Bugun kechqurun Carmen operasiga boraman.

  Madrid — maftunkor shahar, bir kun kelib
  albatta borishing kerak!

                    Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
                    Pol
  ─────────────────────────────────────────


⚠ XATNING TUZILIShI — 105-BETDAGI JEKNING
XATI BILAN BIR XIL:

  1-xatboshi:  SALOM + qayerdaligi + kim
               bilan + qachondan beri
               (Present Perfect: 'I've been
                here SINCE ...')

  2-xatboshi:  QILGAN ishlar
               (Present Perfect → Past Simple
                naqshi)

  3-xatboshi:  QILMAGAN ishlar + REJALAR
               ('haven't ... YET' + 'going to')

  4-xatboshi:  BAHO + tavsiya
               ('a fascinating city —
                you must visit it')

  Yakun:       Best wishes, [ism]


⚠ ENG MUHIM NAQSh — HAR ISh IKKI ZAMONDA:

  'I've BEEN to the Prado Museum.'
     (Present Perfect — umumiy xabar)
  'I WENT there LAST MONDAY.'
     (Past Simple — aniq vaqt)

  'I've also BEEN to Palacio Real.'
  'I WENT there YESTERDAY.'

  Bu — Unit 15 ning oltin qoidasi.


KERAKLI IBORALAR:

  SALOM:
     'Greetings from [shahar]!'
     'I'm having a wonderful time.'

  QANChA VAQT:
     'I've been here SINCE last Monday.'
     'I've been here FOR a week.'

  QILGAN:
     'I've ALREADY visited ...'
     'I've also BEEN to ...'

  QILMAGAN:
     'I haven't ... YET.'

  REJA:
     'I'm GOING TO ...'
     'Tonight I'M GOING to ...'

  YAKUN:
     '... is a fascinating city —
      you must visit it one day!'
     'Best wishes,'


DIQQAT — 'A RESTAURANT CALLED 'LHARDY'':
  'a restaurant CALLED Lhardy' = 'Lhardy'
  deb ataladigan restoran

  'called' — nom berish uchun.


DIQQAT — XATDA OLMOSh:
  Dialogda Pol 'I' deb gapiradi, xat ham
  Poldan yozilgani uchun 'I' saqlanadi.

  (105-betdagi 4b-mashqda esa savolga javob
   berilgani uchun 'he' ga o'zgargan edi.)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a project    = loyiha
  while        = ... paytda
  called       = ... deb ataladigan

     'rode' (ride ning o'tgan zamoni).
     Bo'shliqdan oldin 'I' bor, demak FE'L
     kerak!


ENG NOZIK JOY — 7-BAND:
  'I ................ a camel'

  Bo'shliqdan oldin EGA ('I'), keyin
  TO'LDIRUVCHI ('a camel') — orasida FE'L
  bo'lishi shart.

  Ro'yxatda faqat BITTA fe'l bor: RODE.


DIQQAT — 3-BAND, 'CENTRE':
  'in the CENTRE of Cairo'

  'centre' — britancha yozilishi.
  Amerikacha: 'center'.

  Shu kabi: theatre/theater, metre/meter,
  litre/liter.


DIQQAT — 'BOAT TRIP' — OT + OT:
  'a BOAT trip' — birinchi ot ikkinchisini
  aniqlaydi (qanday sayohat? — qayiqda).

  Shu kabi: a bus stop, a school bag,
  a football match.

  DIQQAT: birinchi ot KO'PLIKDA bo'lmaydi:
     'a boat trip'  ✓
     'a boats trip' ✗


DIQQAT — 'HANDMADE':
  hand + made = qo'l bilan yasalgan
  Qo'shma sifat, birga yoziladi.

  Shu kabi: homemade (uyda tayyorlangan),
  handwritten (qo'lda yozilgan).


DIQQAT — 'FASCINATING' va 'FASCINATED':
  'a FASCINATING city' = maftunkor shahar
     (-ING: narsaning XUSUSIYATI)
  'I am FASCINATED' = men maftun bo'ldim
     (-ED: odamning HISSI)

  Shu kabi: interesting/interested,
  boring/bored, exciting/excited.


GAP TUZISh — NAMUNA GAPLAR:

 1  Luxor is famous for its HUGE TEMPLES.
 2  We are having a WONDERFUL TIME in Egypt.
 3  My hotel is IN THE CENTRE OF the city.
 4  We ate at a TRADITIONAL RESTAURANT last
    night.
 5  I bought some HANDMADE SOUVENIRS at the
    bazaar.
 6  We are going on a BOAT TRIP tomorrow.
 7  I RODE A CAMEL near the Pyramids.
 8  Cairo is a FASCINATING CITY.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  huge        = ulkan
  wonderful   = ajoyib
  the centre  = markaz
  traditional = an'anaviy
  handmade    = qo'lbola
  a boat trip = qayiqda sayohat
  to ride     = minmoq (ride → RODE)
  fascinating = maftunkor

exercises.instructionEn: Replace the adjectives in bold with their opposites.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfdagi sifatlarni ularning ziddi bilan almashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ZID SO'ZLAR RO'YXATI (6 ta):
  disgusting, cold, quiet, horrible, empty,
  modern


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  I'm having a WONDERFUL time.
    → I'm having a HORRIBLE time.

 2  The streets are NOISY and CROWDED.
    → The streets are QUIET and EMPTY.

 3  We've been to a TRADITIONAL restaurant.
    → We've been to a MODERN restaurant.

 4  The food was DELICIOUS.
    → The food was DISGUSTING.

 5  The weather is very HOT.
    → The weather is very COLD.


OLTI ZID JUFTLIK:

  wonderful   ↔  horrible
  (ajoyib)       (dahshatli)

  noisy       ↔  quiet
  (shovqinli)    (jim, tinch)

  crowded     ↔  empty
  (gavjum)       (bo'sh)

  traditional ↔  modern
  (an'anaviy)    (zamonaviy)

  delicious   ↔  disgusting
  (juda mazali)  (jirkanch, badbo'y)

  hot         ↔  cold
  (issiq)        (sovuq)


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDA IKKI SIFAT:
  'The streets are NOISY and CROWDED.'
  Ikkalasi ham qalin harfda, demak
  IKKALASINI ham almashtirish kerak:
     noisy   → quiet
     crowded → empty

  Boshqa bandlarda bittadan.
  Jami 6 sifat, 6 zid so'z — teng.


HAMMASI XATDAN OLINGAN:
  1  'I'm having a WONDERFUL time'
  2  'how NOISY and CROWDED it was'
  3  'a TRADITIONAL restaurant'
  4  'the food was just DELICIOUS'
  5  'The weather is very HOT here'

  Ya'ni bu mashq — xatning TESKARI
  variantini yozish.


DIQQAT — 'DELICIOUS' va 'DISGUSTING':
  delicious  = juda mazali (ovqat haqida)
  disgusting = jirkanch, badbo'y

  'disgusting' — juda kuchli salbiy so'z.
  Yumshoqrog'i: 'not very nice', 'awful'.


DIQQAT — 'QUIET' va 'QUITE' — ADAShTIRMANG!
  QUIET  /ˈkwaɪət/  = jim, tinch (SIFAT)
  QUITE  /kwaɪt/    = ancha (RAVISH)

  'a quiet street'  = tinch ko'cha
  'quite noisy'     = ancha shovqinli

  Yozilishi juda o'xshash, ma'nosi butunlay
  boshqa!


DIQQAT — 'CROWDED' va 'EMPTY':
  crowded = odam to'la, gavjum
  empty   = bo'sh (hech kim/narsa yo'q)

  'a crowd' = olomon (OT)
  'crowded' = gavjum (SIFAT)


DIQQAT — 'HORRIBLE':
  Unit 14 da ham bor edi (99 va 103-betlar):
  'It looks and smells HORRIBLE.'

  'wonderful' ning ziddi sifatida
  'terrible', 'awful' ham bo'lardi, lekin
  ro'yxatda 'horrible' berilgan.


TO'LIQ TESKARI XAT (mashqning natijasi):
  'The weather is very COLD here and I'm
   having a HORRIBLE time. The streets are
   QUIET and EMPTY. We've been to a MODERN
   restaurant. The food was DISGUSTING.'

  Ya'ni butunlay teskari ta'til!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  horrible   = dahshatli
  quiet      = jim, tinch
  empty      = bo'sh
  modern     = zamonaviy
  disgusting = jirkanch
  cold       = sovuq
  crowded    = gavjum
  delicious  = juda mazali
