exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing prepositions, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Yetishmayotgan predloglarni qo'ying, so'ngra ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR RO'YXATI (5 ta):
  for, down, on, with, at

DIQQAT: OLTI bo'shliq bor, lekin BESH
predlog — demak BITTASI IKKI marta
ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  I'm staying WITH my friend
  2  ON Tuesday
  3  AT Giza
  4  go ON a boat trip DOWN the River Nile
  5  famous FOR

  'ON' IKKI marta ishlatiladi (2 va 4).


HAMMASI XATDAN OLINGAN:
  1  'I'm staying WITH my friend, Abdullah.'
  2  'We visited it ON Tuesday.'
  3  'the Pyramids and the Sphinx AT Giza'
  4  'a boat trip DOWN the River Nile' /
     'We are going ON a boat trip tomorrow'
  5  'The place is famous FOR its huge temples'


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'STAY WITH somebody' = birovnikida turmoq
    'with' — hamrohlik.
    DIQQAT: 'stay AT a hotel' (joy),
    lekin 'stay WITH a friend' (odam).

 2  'ON Tuesday' — HAFTA KUNLARI 'on' bilan:
       on Monday, on Friday, on Sunday
    Boshqa vaqt predloglari:
       IN + oy/yil/fasl (in May, in 2010)
       AT + soat (at 5 o'clock)

 3  'AT Giza' — kichik joy nomi 'at' bilan.
    'AT' — aniq nuqta.
    ('IN Cairo' — katta shahar; 'AT Giza' —
     aniq joy.)

 4  IKKI PREDLOG:
    'go ON a boat trip' — sayohatga chiqmoq
       ('on a trip / on holiday / on a
        journey' — turg'un)
    'DOWN the River Nile' — daryo BO'YLAB
       (oqim yo'nalishida)
       Teskarisi: 'UP the river'

 5  'FAMOUS FOR something' = ... bilan mashhur
    'famous FOR its temples'

    DIQQAT: 'famous AS' — boshqa ma'no
    ('He is famous AS a singer' = qo'shiqchi
     sifatida mashhur).


VAQT PREDLOGLARI — QISQA JADVAL:

  AT  →  soat, aniq vaqt
         at 5 o'clock, at night, at noon
  ON  →  kun, sana
         on Tuesday, on 5th May, on Monday
         morning
  IN  →  oy, yil, fasl, qism
         in May, in 2010, in summer,
         in the morning

  DIQQAT — ISTISNO:
     'in the morning' — 'IN' bilan
     'ON Monday morning' — 'ON' bilan
     (kun qo'shilsa 'on' bo'ladi!)


JOY PREDLOGLARI — QISQA JADVAL:

  AT  →  aniq nuqta: at Giza, at the door,
         at the bus stop, at home
  IN  →  ichida: in Cairo, in the room,
         in Egypt
  ON  →  yuzasida: on the table, on the wall


GAP TUZISh — NAMUNA GAPLAR:

 1  I'm staying WITH my friend in Cairo.
 2  We visited the bazaar ON Tuesday.
 3  The Pyramids and the Sphinx are AT Giza.
 4  We are going ON a boat trip DOWN the
    River Nile.
 5  Luxor is famous FOR its huge temples and
    statues.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to stay with = birovnikida turmoq
  Giza         = Giza (ehromlar joylashgan joy)
  to go on a trip = sayohatga chiqmoq
  down the river = daryo bo'ylab
  famous for   = ... bilan mashhur

tasks.prompt: 1  I'm staying ...... my friend
tasks.whyUz:
'STAY WITH somebody' = birovnikida turmoq.
'with' — hamrohlik bildiradi.

DIQQAT — FARQI:
  'stay WITH a friend' (ODAM bilan)
  'stay AT a hotel'    (JOYDA)

Xatdan: 'I'm staying WITH my friend,
Abdullah.'

tasks.prompt: 2  ...... Tuesday
tasks.whyUz:
HAFTA KUNLARI DOIM 'ON' bilan:
  on Monday, on Tuesday, on Sunday

VAQT PREDLOGLARI:
  AT + soat  (at 5 o'clock)
  ON + kun   (on Tuesday)
  IN + oy/yil (in May, in 2010)

Xatdan: 'We visited it ON Tuesday.'

'AT' — aniq, kichik joy uchun.

FARQI:
  'IN Cairo'  — katta shahar (ichida)
  'AT Giza'   — aniq joy/nuqta

Xatdan: 'the Pyramids and the Sphinx AT GIZA'

Giza — Qohira yaqinidagi joy, u yerda uchta
buyuk ehrom va Sfenks bor.

tasks.prompt: 4a  go ...... a boat trip
tasks.whyUz:
'GO ON a trip' — TURG'UN ibora.

Shu kabi:
  go ON holiday, go ON a journey,
  go ON a boat trip, go ON an excursion

DIQQAT: 'on' bu mashqda IKKI marta ishlatiladi
(2 va 4a-bandlar) — chunki 6 bo'shliq, 5 predlog.

Xatdan: 'We are GOING ON A BOAT TRIP
tomorrow.'

tasks.prompt: 4b  ...... the River Nile
tasks.whyUz:
'DOWN the river' = daryo BO'YLAB
(oqim yo'nalishida).

Teskarisi: 'UP the river' (oqimga qarshi).

Nil JANUBDAN SHIMOLGA oqadi, shuning uchun
'down the Nile' — shimolga qarab.

Xatdan: 'a boat trip DOWN THE RIVER NILE'

tasks.prompt: 5  famous ......
tasks.whyUz:
'FAMOUS FOR something' = ... bilan mashhur.

DIQQAT — 'FAMOUS AS' BILAN ADASHTIRMANG:
  'famous FOR its temples' = ma'badlari bilan
     mashhur (NARSA)
  'famous AS a singer' = qo'shiqchi sifatida
     mashhur (KIM sifatida)

Xatdan: 'The place is FAMOUS FOR its huge
temples and statues.'

wordFormation.ruleUz: ⚠ PRESENT PERFECT va PAST SIMPLE — OLTIN QOIDA

Present Perfect uchun III shakl (V3) kerak.

items.derived: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

EVER / NEVER / YET / ALREADY — QAYERDA TURADI

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have already visited the bazaar. I've been to a traditional restaurant.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bozorga allaqachon borganman. An'anaviy restoranda bo'lganman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
O'tmishda sodir bo'lgan, lekin VAQTI
aytilmagan harakat.
'have' + fe'lning III shakli.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I haven't been on a boat trip yet. I haven't visited the Egyptian Museum.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hali qayiqda sayohat qilmadim. Misr muzeyiga bormadim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'YET' = hali — INKOR gapda, GAP OXIRIDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: HAVE + [EGA] + EVER + [V3] ... ?   —  Yes, I HAVE. / No, I HAVEN'T.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you ever been there? — Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hech u yerda bo'lganmisiz? — Ha. / Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'EVER' — savolda 'hech qachon'.
Qisqa javobda faqat 'have/haven't' qoladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you ever been to Egypt? — Yes. — When did you go? — I went two years ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Misrda bo'lganmisiz? — Ha. — Qachon borgandingiz? — Ikki yil oldin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ ANIQ VAQT so'ralganda PAST SIMPLE.
'I have been there two years ago' — XATO!

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Picture 4 shows the Sphinx. Picture 6 shows a Pharaoh's mask.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 4-rasm Sfenksni ko'rsatadi. 6-rasm fir'avn niqobini ko'rsatadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Rasm tasvirlash qolipi.
'in picture 4' — artikl YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've already visited the bazaar. We visited it on Tuesday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bozorga allaqachon borganman. Uni seshanba kuni ko'rdik.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ XATNING ASOSIY NAQSHI:
Avval PRESENT PERFECT (umumiy xabar),
keyin PAST SIMPLE (aniq vaqt bilan tafsilot).

sentencePatterns.formula: HAS + [ega] + [V3] ... ?  —  Yes, he HAS.  —  WHEN DID he [V1] it?  —  On Tuesday.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has Jack visited the bazaar? — Yes, he has. — When did he visit it? — On Tuesday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jek bozorga borganmi? — Ha. — Qachon borgan? — Seshanba kuni.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'WHEN' so'ralishi bilan zamon PAST SIMPLE
ga o'tadi.
'When HAS he visited?' — XATO!

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've been here since Monday. I've been here for three days.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dushanbadan beri shu yerdaman. Uch kundan beri shu yerdaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SINCE — boshlanish NUQTASI (Monday, 2010)
FOR — DAVOMIYLIK (three days, two years)

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I haven't been on a boat trip yet. There are a lot of things I haven't done yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hali qayiqda sayohat qilmadim. Hali qilmagan ko'p ishlarim bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'YET' — INKOR gapda, GAP OXIRIDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHAT IS / WAS + [ega] + LIKE?  —  It IS / WAS + [sifat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is the weather like? — It is very hot. What was it like? — It was noisy and crowded.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Havo qanday? — Juda issiq. U qanday edi? — Shovqinli va gavjum edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'like' bu yerda = 'qanday' ('yoqmoq' EMAS).
Javobda 'like' TAKRORLANMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The place is famous for its huge temples and statues.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U joy ulkan ma'badlari va haykallari bilan mashhur.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'famous FOR' — narsa bilan mashhur.
'famous AS' — kim sifatida mashhur.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have cleaned it. He has cleaned it. They haven't cleaned it. She hasn't cleaned it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men uni tozalaganman. U tozalagan. Ular tozalamagan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
HAS — faqat he/she/it;
HAVE — qolgan hammasi.

sentencePatterns.formula: HAVE / HAS + [ega] + [V3] ... ?   —   Yes, I HAVE. / No, I HAVEN'T.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you been to Turkey? — Yes, I have. Has he been to Turkey? — No, he hasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Turkiyada bo'lganmisiz? — Ha. U bo'lganmi? — Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
So'roqda 'do' KERAK EMAS.
Qisqa javobda qisqartma ISHLATILMAYDI
('Yes, I've' XATO).

sentencePatterns.formula: HAVE you EVER + [V3] ... ?  —  WHEN DID you + [V1] ... ?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you ever visited Prague? — Yes, I have. — When did you visit Prague? — Last summer.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pragaga borganmisiz? — Ha. — Qachon borgansiz? — O'tgan yozda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Savolda V3, 'did' dan keyin V1!
'When did you visited' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've never been to China. I've never ridden a camel.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xitoyda hech qachon bo'lmaganman. Hech qachon tuyaga minmaganman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'never' O'ZI INKOR — 'haven't never' XATO.
'never' — have va V3 ORASIDA.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's the best country I've ever visited. It's the most beautiful city I've ever seen.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu men borgan eng yaxshi mamlakat. Bu men ko'rgan eng go'zal shahar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'that' tushirib qoldirilgan.
Bu qurilmada 'ever' TASDIQ gapda keladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've already packed it. I haven't packed it yet. Have you packed it yet?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Allaqachon yig'ib bo'ldim. Hali yig'madim. Yig'ib bo'ldingizmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
ALREADY — tasdiqda, have va V3 ORASIDA.
YET — savol/inkorda, GAP OXIRIDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: HAVE + [ega] + [V3] ... YET?  —  Yes, ... have ALREADY [V3].  /  No, ... HAVEN'T [V3] ... YET.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have they visited the Eiffel Tower yet? — Yes, they have already visited it. — No, they haven't been to Versailles yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular Eyfel minorasiga bordimi? — Ha, allaqachon borishgan. — Yo'q, hali Versalga borishmagan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
YET — savol/inkorda, GAP OXIRIDA.
ALREADY — tasdiqda, have va V3 ORASIDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: Have you [V3] ... YET?  —  Yes, I've JUST [V3] it/them/him.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you booked a table yet? — Yes, I've just booked it. Have you found the tickets yet? — Yes, I've just found them.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Stol band qildingizmi? — Ha, hozirgina. Chiptalarni topdingizmi? — Ha, hozirgina.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
JUST = hozirgina.
⚠ Olmoshga e'tibor: birlik → IT,
ko'plik → THEM, odam → HIM/HER.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He has lived in Rome for three years. I haven't travelled by plane since 1987.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U uch yildan beri Rimda yashaydi. 1987-yildan beri samolyotda uchmaganman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
FOR + qancha vaqt; SINCE + qachondan beri.
INKOR gapda ham ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How long have you been here? — Since last Monday. / For five days.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri turibsiz? — O'tgan dushanbadan beri. / Besh kundan beri.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'How long' savoli DOIM Present Perfect bilan
(agar hozir ham davom etayotgan bo'lsa).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have already visited the Prado Museum. I went there last Monday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Prado muzeyiga allaqachon bordim. O'tgan dushanba kuni bordim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ UNIT 15 NING ASOSIY NAQSHI:
Avval Present Perfect (xabar),
keyin Past Simple (aniq vaqt bilan tafsilot).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tip your bellboy generously, and you'll have the perfect holiday. Don't tip him, and you'll have the worst holiday of your life!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xizmatchiga saxiylik bilan choychaqa bering — mukammal ta'til o'tkazasiz. Bermang — eng yomon ta'til bo'ladi!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bu yerda 'AND' = 'shunda'.
Unit 14 dagi 'OR' = 'aks holda' ning
teskarisi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Guests who don't tip well often find that ... Anyone who is planning to stay in an American hotel should remember ...
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yaxshi choychaqa bermaydigan mehmonlar ko'pincha sezishadi ... Amerika mehmonxonasida turishni rejalashtirayotgan har kim esda tutsin ...
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'WHO' — ODAMLAR uchun ergash gap

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Americans take tipping more seriously than any other nationality. No one takes tipping as seriously as hotel bellboys do.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Amerikaliklar choychaqa berishga har qanday millatdan jiddiyroq qaraydi. Hech kim xizmatchilardek jiddiy qaramaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'MORE ... THAN' — qiyos;
'AS ... AS' — tenglik.

sentencePatterns.formula: WOULD YOU LIKE TO + [fe'l] ?  —  Yes, that would be great!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There's a good film on at the Odeon tonight. Would you like to go? — Yes, that would be great!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun Odeonda yaxshi kino bor. Borishni xohlaysanmi? — Ha, zo'r bo'lardi!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TAKLIF qilish shakli.
Rad etish: 'I'd love to, but I can't.'

sentencePatterns.formula: I'M LOOKING FOR + [narsa].  —  How much is it?  —  I'LL TAKE IT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm looking for a gift for my brother. — How much is it? — It's only £10. — I'll take it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Akamga sovg'a qidiryapman. — Qancha turadi? — Atigi 10 funt. — Olaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Do'kondagi savdo suhbati.
'I'LL take it' — ayni damdagi qaror (WILL).

sentencePatterns.formula: I'D LIKE TO BOOK A TABLE FOR + [vaqt/kishi soni].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'd like to book a table for tonight. — A table for two at nine o'clock, please.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun kechqurunga stol band qilmoqchi edim. — Soat to'qqizda ikki kishiga stol, iltimos.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Restoranda joy band qilish shakli.
'a table FOR two' — necha kishiga.
